qe: Which type of bond is formed by the 'Complete Transfer' of electrons from one atom to another?
qh: एक परमाणु से दूसरे परमाणु में इलेक्ट्रॉनों के 'पूर्ण स्थानांतरण' से किस प्रकार का बंध बनता है?
e: Ionic (electrovalent) bond tab banta hai jab ek atom ke paas electron zyada ho (dhatu) aur doosre ko kam (adhatu) - dhatu apne valence electron poore chhod deti hai aur adhatu unhe le leti hai, jisse dhanayan (cation) aur rinayan (anion) ban kar vidyut aakarshan se jud jaate hain (jaise Na+ aur Cl-). Isliye yahan electron ka poora sthanantaran (transfer) hota hai, saanjha nahi. Covalent bond mein electron saanjhe hote hain, coordinate bond mein ek hi atom joda deta hai, aur hydrogen bond durbal aakarshan hota hai - isliye wo vikalp is paribhasha ke nahi hain. Exam point: ionic bond = electron ka poora sthanantaran (dhatu se adhatu ko), jisse cation-anion ka vidyut aakarshan banta hai.

qe: A bond formed by the 'Sharing' of electrons between two atoms is called:
qh: दो परमाणुओं के बीच इलेक्ट्रॉनों के 'साझेदारी' से बनने वाले बंध को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Covalent bond tab banta hai jab do atom apne-apne valence electron saanjha karke dono ka octet poora kar lete hain - jaise H2 (ek-ek electron), Cl2 (ek-ek), ya CH4 (carbon chaar electron saanjha karta hai). Isme koi ion nahi banta, isliye ye vidyut-udasheeni (neutral) molecule deta hai aur aam taur par dhatu-adhatu ke beech nahi, balki adhatuon ke beech banta hai. Ionic bond electron ke sthanantaran se banta hai aur metallic bond dhaatuon mein electron samudra se - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: covalent bond = electron jode ka saanjha hona (dono atom octet poora karte hain); isme ion nahi bante.

qe: Which of the following molecules contains a 'Triple Bond'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु में 'त्रि-बंध' (Triple Bond) उपस्थित होता है?
e: Nitrogen (N2) molecule mein dono nitrogen atom teen jode electron saanjha karte hain - yani ek triple bond (N triple-bond N) banta hai, jiske karan ye bahut sthir aur inert hai (isliye hawa mein 78% nitrogen hote hue bhi wo aam taur par kriya nahi karta). Triple bond ki bond order 3 hoti hai aur ye sabse mazbut bond hai. H2 mein single bond, O2 mein double bond hota hai, aur NaCl ionic bond ka udaharan hai - isliye wo teeno vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: N2 mein nitrogen ke beech triple bond (bond order 3) hota hai, isliye nitrogen gas bahut sthir aur lagbhag nishkriya hai.

qe: The bond present in 'Common Salt' (NaCl) is:
qh: 'साधारण नमक' (NaCl) में कौन सा बंध उपस्थित होता है?
e: Common salt (NaCl) mein sodium dhatu apna ek valence electron chlorine ko de deta hai; isse Na+ dhanayan aur Cl- rinayan bante hain aur vidyut aakarshan se dono ek kristal mein jud jaate hain - isliye ye ionic bond hai. Isi karan NaCl ka galaank 801 degree C hota hai, paani mein ghul kar ion deta hai aur pighli avastha (melt) mein bijli chalaata hai. Covalent bond (jaise CH4) mein electron saanjhe hote hain, metallic bond dhaatuon mein hota hai aur hydrogen bond durbal aakarshan hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi. Exam point: NaCl mein ionic bond hai (Na+ aur Cl-), isliye ye paani mein ion deta hai aur elektrolite ki tarah kaam karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Shape' of a Methane ($CH_4$) molecule?
qh: मीथेन ($CH_4$) अणु की 'आकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Methane (CH4) mein carbon ke chaar valence electron chaar hydrogen ke saath chaar covalent bond banate hain; carbon sp3 hybridised hota hai, isliye chaar bond ek doosre se hamesha 109 degree 28 minute ke kon par rehte hain aur shape tetrahedral banta hai (jayamiti ke saare kon barabar). Planar (samtal) shape tab hoti hai jab sab atom ek hi tal (plane) mein hon (jaise BF3), linear tab jab do hi atom ya do kone ho (jaise CO2), aur octahedral tab jab 6 atom ho (jaise SF6). Exam point: CH4 ka shape tetrahedral (sp3 carbon, bond angle 109 degree 28 minute) hota hai - isliye ye teen-aayami (3D) hai, samtal nahi.

qe: Which type of bond is responsible for the 'High Boiling Point' of water?
qh: जल के 'उच्च क्वथनांक' के लिए किस प्रकार का बंध उत्तरदायी होता है?
e: Paani (H2O) ke molecule mein oxygen bahut vidyut-rinaatmak (electronegative) hai, isliye ek paani ke oxygen atom aur doosre paani ke hydrogen ke beech durbal vidyut aakarshan (hydrogen bond) ban jaata hai - inhi hydrogen bonds ko todne ke liye adhik urja chahiye, isliye paani ka kvathank (boiling point) 100 degree C aur doosre halke hydrides se bahut adhik hota hai. Covalent bond molecule ke andar hota hai (O-H), ionic bond paani mein nahi hota, aur van der Waals bal sirf durbal takkar ka asar hota hai. Exam point: paani ke uchch kvathank ka karan hydrogen bond hai (O-H...O ka aakarshan), jo molecule ke andar ke covalent bond se alag hai.

qe: An 'Octet Rule' suggests that atoms are most stable when they have how many electrons in their outer shell?
qh: 'अष्टक नियम' के अनुसार परमाणु तब सबसे स्थिर होते हैं जब उनके बाहरी कोश में कितने इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं?
e: Octet rule kehta hai ki atom tab sabse sthir hota hai jab uske sabse bahari kosh (outer shell) mein 8 electron ho jaayein - yahi noble gas (jaise neon) ka sthir vinyas (configuration) hota hai. Isi karan atom electron dete, lete ya saanjha karte hain taaki 8 ka aankda poora ho (H aur He ke liye 2 ka niyam chalta hai, kyunki unka pehla shell hi bharta hai). 2, 6 ya 10 aankde octet nahi hain - valency kosh mein bhare hue electron ki khaas sankhya 8 hi hai. Exam point: octet rule ke anusar bahari kosh mein 8 electron hone par atom sabse sthir hota hai (hydrogen-helium ke liye 2 ka niyam).

qe: Which of the following is an example of a 'Polar Covalent' molecule?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'ध्रुवीय सहसंयोजक' अणु का उदाहरण है?
e: Polar covalent molecule wo hota hai jismein bond covalent to hai par electron ka saanjha barabar nahi - ek atom (adhik vidyut-rinaatmak) electron jode ko apni taraf zyada khinch leta hai, jisse ek sira thoda rinaveshi (delta minus) aur doosra thoda dhanaveshi (delta plus) ho jaata hai. HCl iska sabse aam udaharan hai (chlorine hydrogen se zyada vidyut-rinaatmak), isliye ismein aaynik aavesh ka jhukaav paida hota hai. N2, O2 jaise same atom wale molecule mein electron barabar saanjha hota hai (non-polar), aur H2 bhi non-polar hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: polar covalent bond wahan banta hai jahan vidyut-rinaatmakta ka antar ho (jaise HCl), jisse molecule mein thoda aavesh ka antar (dipole) banta hai.

qe: The 'Geometry' of a Water ($H_2O$) molecule is:
qh: जल ($H_2O$) अणु की 'ज्यामिति' कैसी होती है?
e: Paani (H2O) mein oxygen ke paas do bond jode aur do akela joda (lone pairs) hote hain; akela joda electron ghanatva zyada hone ke karan bond jodon ko thoda neeche dhakel deta hai (VSEPR ke anusar vikarshan ka kram: akela-akela > akela-bond > bond-bond), isliye molecule seedha-seedha nahi rehta aur mudo (bent ya V-shaped) ho jaata hai, jiska bond angle lagbhag 104.5 degree hota hai. Isi mudav ke karan paani polar banta hai. Linear (jaise CO2), trigonal planar (BF3) ya tetrahedral (CH4) shape yahan nahi banti - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: H2O ka shape bent (V-shaped) hota hai kyunki oxygen par do akela joda hota hai; isliye bond angle 104.5 degree rehta hai (109 se kam).

qe: What is 'Hybridization'?
qh: 'संकरण' (Hybridization) क्या है?
o: Mixing of atomic orbitals to form new equivalent orbitals
e: Hybridisation wo ganit-meet (conceptual) prakriya hai jismein ek hi atom ke alag-alag urja-star wale parmaanu kaksh (atomic orbitals) aapas mein milkar barabar urja wale naye sankar (hybrid) orbitals banate hain, jisse bond banane mein adhik saamya (overlap) milta hai aur molecule zyada sthir hota hai. Jaise carbon sp3 (4 orbital, 109 degree), sp2 (3 orbital, 120 degree) aur sp (2 orbital, 180 degree) hybridisation karta hai. Electron daan-lena, ion banna ya hydrogen bond iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: hybridisation = ek hi atom ke atomic orbitals ka mil kar barabar urja ke naye hybrid orbitals banana (sp, sp2, sp3, sp3d...), jisse geometry tay hoti hai.

qe: Which of the following compounds has the 'Highest' melting point?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस यौगिक का गलनांक 'उच्चतम' होता है?
e: NaCl ek aaynik (ionic) thos padarth hai jismein Na+ aur Cl- ke beech prabal vidyut aakarshan (ionic bond) hota hai; is strong lattice ke karan ushe todne ke liye bahut urja lagti hai, isliye uska galaank (melting point) 801 degree C hota hai. Iske mukable sugar, wax aur CO2 jaise molecular/covalent padarth durbal van der Waals bal se bandhe hote hain, isliye kam tapman par pighal jaate hain. 'Ionic bond prabal hota hai, covalent ya molecular bond se zyada' - yahi tark is prashn ka sahi uttar deta hai. Exam point: NaCl ka melting point sabse adhik hota hai kyunki ismein prabal ionic lattice (aaynik bandhan) hota hai; molecular padarth ke galaank kam hote hain.

qe: In a 'Coordinate Covalent Bond', the shared pair of electrons is provided by:
qh: 'उपसहसंयोजक बंध' में इलेक्ट्रॉनों का साझा युग्म किसके द्वारा प्रदान किया जाता है?
e: Coordinate covalent (dative) bond mein electron joda (pair) sirf ek hi atom deta hai, par dono atom ushe saanjha karke use apne-apne octet ke liye istemal karte hain - jaise NH3 apne akela jode (lone pair) se H+ ko bandhta hai aur NH4+ banta hai. Isliye is me ek pura donor aur ek acceptor hota hai, baad mein ye bond aam covalent bond jaisa hi ban jaata hai (dono ore barabar). Saadhaaran covalent bond mein dono atom ek-ek electron dete hain aur ionic bond mein electron pura chala jaata hai - isliye wo vikalp is paribhasha ke nahi hain. Exam point: coordinate bond mein electron joda keval ek atom (donor) deta hai; dusra atom (acceptor) use saanjha karta hai - jaise NH4+ aur H3O+ mein.

qe: Which force is the 'Weakest' among the following?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा बल सबसे 'कमजोर' है?
e: Van der Waals bal sabse durbal aakarshan hota hai - ye molecule ke us samay bane turant (instantaneous) dipole ya unke swabhavik dipole ke aapas mein lagne wale bahut halke aakarshan se banta hai (jaise noble gas aur I2 jaise padarth isi se sthir rehte hain). Iske mukable hydrogen bond (lagbhag 5-10 guna prabal), covalent bond aur ionic bond kaafi zyada prabal hote hain, isliye unhain todna mushkil hota hai. Isi karan van der Waals bal wale padarth ka galaank-kvathank bahut kam hota hai (jaise argon, CO2 mostly gas hain). Exam point: sabse durbal bal = van der Waals aakarshan (instantaneous dipole se), jabki ionic, covalent aur hydrogen bond usse prabal hote hain.

qe: The 'Bond Angle' in a linear molecule like $CO_2$ is:
qh: $CO_2$ जैसे रेखीय अणु में 'बंध कोण' कितना होता है?
e: CO2 mein carbon sp hybridised hota hai aur uske dono or oxygen atom seedha (linear) judte hain, isliye unke beech ka bond angle 180 degree hota hai (O=C=O). Yahi karan hai ki CO2 ka dipole moment bhi zero ho jaata hai - dono taraf ke polo ek doosre ko kaat dete hain. 109 degree 28 minute tetrahedral (CH4) ka, 120 degree trigonal planar (BF3) ka aur 104.5 degree bent (H2O) ka kon hota hai - isliye wo teeno vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: linear molecule (CO2, BeCl2) ka bond angle 180 degree hota hai (sp hybridisation), isliye ye seedha rehta hai.

qe: Which molecule has 'Zero' dipole moment?
qh: किस अणु का द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण 'शून्य' होता है?
e: CO2 ka dipole moment zero hota hai kyunki ismein carbon ke dono or oxygen ke bond polar hote hain par dono dipole bilkul ulte (opposite) disha mein hote hain aur barabar hote hain, isliye wo ek doosre ko poora kaat dete hain. Isi karan CO2 non-polar molecule hai (halanki C-O bond polar hai). Paani ka dipole moment 1.85 D hota hai, HCl ka lagbhag 1.08 D, aur NH3 ka 1.47 D - kyunki unke aakaar (bent/pyramidal) ke karan dipoles kaatan nahi paate. Exam point: jis molecule mein polar bonds ek doosre ko poora kaat dein (jaise CO2 linear ya CCl4 tetrahedral), uska net dipole moment zero hota hai.

qe: Metallic bonds are characterized by a 'Sea of':
qh: धात्विक बंध को किसके 'समुद्र' (Sea) द्वारा वर्णित किया जाता है?
e: Metallic bond mein dhaatu ke valence electron poore lattice mein swatantra roop se ghoomte hain - isi samuh ko 'electron samudra (sea of mobile electrons)' kehte hain, aur dhaatu ke dhanaveshi kan (cations) is samudra mein baithe rehte hain. Yahi karan hai ki dhaatu bijli aur garmi ke achhe chaalak, lachile (malleable) aur chamakdar hote hain. 'Proton ka samudra', 'neutron ka samudra' ya 'ion ka samudra' wale kathan vigyaan sammat nahi hain, kyunki ghoomne wale kan electron hote hain. Exam point: metallic bond ka aadhaar = mobile (swatantra) electron ka samudra, jo dhaatuon ko bijli-garmi ka chaalak aur lachila banata hai.

qe: What is the hybridization of Beryllium in $BeCl_2$?
qh: $BeCl_2$ में बेरिलियम का संकरण क्या होता है?
e: BeCl2 mein beryllium ka atomic number 4 hota hai - uske paas sirf 2 valence electron hote hain, isliye do chlorine ke saath do bond banane ke liye uske 2s aur ek 2p orbital milkar do barabar sp hybrid orbitals banate hain; isi se bond angle 180 degree aur linear shape milta hai. BeCl2 kovalent hai par vapour avastha mein linear. sp2 (3 orbital, 120 degree) aur sp3 (4 orbital, 109 degree 28 minute) tab hote hain jab teen ya chaar bond banein - isliye wo BeCl2 ke liye sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: BeCl2 mein beryllium ka hybridisation sp hota hai (linear, bond angle 180 degree), kyunki uske paas keval do valence electron hote hain.

qe: Which molecule contains both 'Ionic and Covalent' bonds?
qh: किस अणु में 'आयनिक और सहसंयोजक' दोनों बंध उपस्थित होते हैं?
e: KCN mein potassium (K) aur cyanide (CN) ke beech ionic bond hota hai - K apna electron CN samuh ko de deta hai aur K+ tatha CN- bante hain; par CN ke andar carbon aur nitrogen ke beech covalent bond (triple bond) hota hai, kyunki dono adhatu electron saanjha karte hain. Isi karan aise padarth 'dwi-svabhav' (donor) dikhate hain - paani mein ye ion dete hain par andar covalent bandhan ki mazbooti bani rehti hai. NaCl (sirf ionic), CH4 (sirf covalent) aur N2 (sirf covalent) mein dono bond ek saath nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: KCN jaise padarth mein ionic aur covalent dono bond hote hain (K+ aur CN- ke beech ionic, CN ke andar covalent).

qe: What is the 'Bond Order' of an Oxygen ($O_2$) molecule?
qh: ऑक्सीजन ($O_2$) अणु का 'बंध क्रम' (Bond Order) क्या होता है?
e: Oxygen (O2) molecule mein 8 bonding electron aur 4 antibonding electron hote hain; isliye bond order = (bonding - antibonding) / 2 = (8 - 4) / 2 = 2 hoti hai, yaani O2 mein double bond hota hai. Bond order jitna adhik hoti hai, bond utna hi chhota aur mazbut hota hai - isliye O2 ka bond N2 ke triple bond se kam mazbut hota hai. 1, 2.5 ya 0 jaise aankde anya molecules (H2, O2+ ion, He2) ke hote hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: O2 ki bond order 2 hoti hai (8 bonding aur 4 antibonding electron), isliye O2 mein double bond hota hai.

qe: The 'VSEPR Theory' is used to predict the:
qh: 'VSEPR सिद्धांत' का उपयोग किसका अनुमान लगाने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: VSEPR theory (Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion) kehti hai ki kisi bhi atom ke chaaron taraf maujood electron jode (bond jode aur akela jode) ek doosre se sabse door rehne ki koshish karte hain; isi vikarshan (repulsion) ke hisaab se molecule ka aakaar (geometry) ban jaata hai - jaise 2 jode = linear, 3 jode = trigonal planar, 4 jode = tetrahedral, 5 = trigonal bipyramidal, 6 = octahedral. Isliye ye theory aakaar batane ke liye istemal hoti hai, bond ki mazbuti ya galaank ke liye nahi. Exam point: VSEPR theory molecule ka aakaar (molecular geometry) batati hai - electron jodon ke vikarshan ke aadhaar par (akela joda > bond joda vikarshan).

qe: The 'Octet Rule' is violated in which of the following molecules?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु में 'अष्टक नियम' का उल्लंघन होता है?
e: Octet rule ke hisab se har atom apne bahari kosh mein 8 electron rakhna chahta hai, par phosphorus pentachloride (PCl5) mein phosphorus ke chaaron taraf 10 electron bandh jaate hain (5 bond x 2 electron) - yani phosphorus ka octet fail ho jaata hai; isi karan ye 'expanded octet' ka udaharan hai (ye 3s, 3p aur 3d orbital ka istemal karke 5 bond banata hai). SF6 mein 12 electron hoke aur bhi fail hota hai. CH4 aur H2O mein octet poora rehta hai, isliye ye dono is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: octet rule ka ullanghan (violation) 'expanded octet' wale padarthon mein hota hai, jaise PCl5 (10 electron) aur SF6 (12 electron) - kyunki ye d-orbital istemal karte hain.

qe: Which 'Bond' is the strongest among the following?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'बंध' सबसे मजबूत होता है?
e: Triple bond sabse mazbut hota hai kyunki ismein teen jode electron (ek sigma + do pi bond) saanjhe hote hain - isliye iski bond order 3 hoti hai, bond ki lambai kam aur bond enthalpy bahut adhik hoti hai (jaise N triple-bond N ya C triple-bond C). Double bond (bond order 2) aur single bond (bond order 1) isse kamzor hote hain, aur hydrogen bond to bahut hi durbal aakarshan hota hai (bond hi nahi, aakarshan hai). Isliye 'triple bond' hi is prashn ka sahi jod hai. Exam point: sabse prabal bond = triple bond (ek sigma + do pi, bond order 3), kyunki teen jode electron saanjhe hote hain aur bond lambai sabse kam hoti hai.

qe: The 'Paramagnetic' nature of Oxygen ($O_2$) is best explained by:
qh: ऑक्सीजन ($O_2$) की 'अनुचुंबकीय' प्रकृति की सबसे अच्छी व्याख्या किसके द्वारा की जाती है?
e: Hawayen (O2) ke paramagnetic hone ka saval Molecular Orbital Theory (MOT) se suljha - is theory ke anusar O2 ke do prati-bandhan (antibonding) pi orbital mein do ayugm (unpaired) electron hote hain, isliye O2 chumbakiya kshetra se halka aakarshit hota hai (paramagnetic). Valence bond theory is tathya ki vyakhya nahi kar paati kyunki octet ke aadhaar par O2 mein sab electron jode mein dikhte hain. MOT hi bond order, paramagnetism aur dhanayan/rinayan ki upasthiti bhi batati hai. Exam point: O2 ke paramagnetic swabhav ki sahi vyakhya Molecular Orbital Theory deti hai - pi antibonding orbital mein do unpaired electron hone ke karan.

qe: What is the hybridization of 'Graphite'?
qh: 'ग्रेफाइट' में कार्बन का संकरण क्या होता है?
e: Graphite mein har carbon atom apne teen padosi carbon ke saath teen sigma bond banata hai; iske liye teen orbital (ek 2s aur do 2p) milkar teen sp2 hybrid orbital banate hain, aur chautha electron (pz orbital) parat ke bahar reh kar aas-paas ki paraton ke saath pi bond banaata hai - isi karan graphite vidyut chalaata hai aur patli paraton (layers) mein banta hai. sp3 hota to heera jaisa teen-aayami dhancha banta, aur sp hota to sirf do bond bante. Exam point: graphite ka carbon sp2 hybridised hota hai (teen sigma bond, 120 degree, samtal paratein) aur chautha electron pi bond se vidyut-chaalakta deta hai.

qe: What is the 'Geometry' of a molecule with 3 bond pairs and 1 lone pair (e.g., $NH_3$)?
qh: 3 बंध युग्म और 1 एकाकी युग्म वाले अणु (उदा. $NH_3$) की 'ज्यामिति' कैसी होती है?
e: NH3 mein nitrogen ke chaar jode hote hain - teen bond jode (hydrogen ke saath) aur ek akela joda (lone pair); electron jodon ka aakaar tetrahedral hota hai, par akela joda ek jagah rok leta hai, isliye sirf atomon se bani shape 'trigonal pyramidal' ho jaati hai (bond angle 107 degree, 109 se thoda kam kyunki akela joda bond jodon ko dhakelta hai). Isliye NH3 seedha-saadha tetrahedral nahi dikhta. Trigonal planar (BF3), bent (H2O) aur linear (CO2) anya jode ki shape hain. Exam point: 3 bond jode + 1 akela joda = trigonal pyramidal shape (jaise NH3, bond angle 107 degree); 2 bond jode + 2 akela jode = bent shape.

qe: Which 'Bond' is formed between atoms of significantly different electronegativities?
qh: काफी भिन्न विद्युतऋणात्मकता वाले परमाणुओं के बीच कौन सा बंध बनता है?
e: Jab do atomon ki vidyut-rinaatmakta (electronegativity) mein kaafi antar ho par itna bhi na ho ki ion bana le (pura electron transfer), tab electron joda ek taraf zyada khinch jaata hai - aise bond ko polar covalent bond kehte hain, jaise HCl, HF, H2O mein. Isse molecule mein dhanaveshi aur rinaveshi sira banta hai (dipole), jiski vajah se paani jaise padarth doosre polar padarthon ko ghula lete hain. Non-polar bond (same atom, jaise H2) mein antar nahi hota, ionic bond mein antar bahut adhik hota hai (dhatu-adhatu), aur metallic bond dhaatuon ke beech hota hai. Exam point: vidyut-rinaatmakta mein badi dij (jaise 1.7 ke aas-paas se kam par kaafi antar) hone par polar covalent bond banta hai - jaise HCl, HF.

qe: What is the 'Bond Angle' in a molecule with $sp^2$ hybridization (e.g., $BF_3$)?
qh: $sp^2$ संकरण वाले अणु (उदा. $BF_3$) में 'बंध कोण' कितना होता है?
e: sp2 hybridisation mein ek s orbital aur do p orbital milkar teen barabar (equivalent) hybrid orbitals banate hain; teeno ek hi samtal (plane) mein ek doosre se barabar door rehte hain, isliye unke beech ka kon 360/3 = 120 degree hota hai - jaise BF3 mein boron ke teeno bond 120 degree par hote hain. sp (linear) mein 180 degree aur sp3 (tetrahedral) mein 109 degree 28 minute hota hai. Isi karan BF3 samtal (planar) molecule hota hai. Exam point: sp2 hybridisation ka bond angle 120 degree hota hai (trigonal planar, jaise BF3, aur graphite ke carbon mein bhi).

qe: Which molecule has 'Zero' net dipole moment despite having polar bonds?
qh: ध्रुवीय बंध होने के बावजूद किस अणु का शुद्ध द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण 'शून्य' होता है?
e: CCl4 mein chaar C-Cl bond hote hain jo polar hote hain (chlorine carbon se zyada vidyut-rinaatmak), par molecule ka aakaar tetrahedral hone ke karan chaaron dipole bilkul barabar aur ek doosre ke ulte (opposite) disha mein hote hain - isliye chaaron dipole ek doosre ko poori tarah nishkriya (cancel) kar dete hain aur net dipole moment zero ho jaata hai. Isi karan CCl4 non-polar solvent ki tarah kaam karta hai, halanki uske bonds polar hain. Paani, HCl aur NH3 ke dipoles barabar nahi kaatte (unka aakaar bent/pyramidal hai), isliye unka net dipole moment zero nahi hota. Exam point: saman (symmetric) aakaar wale molecule mein polar bonds ek doosre ko kaat dete hain, isliye CCl4 ka net dipole moment zero hota hai.

qe: Which type of 'Interaction' holds the two strands of DNA together?
qh: डीएनए की दोनों श्रृंखलाओं को आपस में किस प्रकार का बंध थामे रखता है?
e: DNA ke do strands (dhage) ek doosre se hydrogen bond se jude rehte hain - adenine thymine ke saath do hydrogen bond aur guanine cytosine ke saath teen hydrogen bond banata hai; isliye ye bond durbal hote hain aur DNA ko garam karne par (ya helicase enzyme se) dono strands alag ho jaate hain (denaturation), jisse replication aur transcription sambhav hoti hai. Covalent bond DNA ke andar (sugar-phosphate backbone mein) hota hai, isliye backbone majboot rehta hai; ionic ya metallic bond yahan kaam nahi karte. Exam point: DNA ke do strands hydrogen bond se jurte hain (A-T ke 2, G-C ke 3 bond), isliye ye strands alag kiye ja sakte hain bina backbone toot ne ke.

qe: Which 'Bond' is the shortest and strongest?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्बन बंध सबसे छोटा और सबसे मजबूत होता है?
e: Bond ki lambai aur mazbuti bond order par nirbhar karti hai - C triple-bond C mein bond order 3 hoti hai, isliye ye C=C (order 2) aur C-C (order 1) se chhota aur zyada mazbut hota hai; isi karan alkyne (triple bond wale) ki lambai kam dikhti hai. Triple C triple-bond C ka amash (length) lagbhag 120 pikometre aur C-C ka lagbhag 154 pikometre hota hai. Isliye 'sabse chhota aur sabse prabal' ka sahi jod triple bond hai, single ya double bond nahi. Exam point: sabse chhota aur sabse mazbut carbon-carbon bond = C triple-bond C (triple bond), kyunki bond order 3 hone se atom nazdeek aur bandhan mazbut ho jaata hai.

qe: Who proposed the 'Octet Rule'?
qh: 'अष्टक नियम' का प्रस्ताव किसने दिया था?
e: Octet rule ko Lewis aur Kossel ne 1916-1919 ke aas-paas prastut kiya - inke anusar atom bahari kosh mein 8 electron (noble gas jaisa vinyas) paana chahte hain, isliye dhatuein electron deti hain aur adhatuein lete ya saanjha karte hain. Isi niyam se hum aaynik aur covalent bond samajh paate hain. Rutherford nucleus ke liye, Bohr energy levels ke liye aur Pauli ke spin ke liye jaane jaate hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Lewis aur Kossel ne octet rule prastut kiya; iske anusar atom 8 electron ka vinyas paana chahta hai, isliye ionic aur covalent bandhan bante hain.

qe: Which of the following molecules has a 'Trigonal Bipyramidal' geometry?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु की ज्यामिति 'त्रिकोणीय द्विपिरामिडीय' होती है?
e: PCl5 mein phosphorus ke chaaron taraf 5 bond jode hote hain aur koi akela joda nahi hota; isliye VSEPR ke anusar shape ke saare paanch electron jode ek saath rahne ke liye trigonal bipyramidal (tribhujiya dvipiramid) ban jaate hain - isme teen bond ek samtal (equatorial) mein 120 degree par aur do bond upar-neeche (axial) 90 degree par hote hain. Isi karan PCl5 ke galaank-kvathank alag hote hain aur ye octet bhi todta hai. Tetrahedral (CH4), square planar (XeF4) aur octahedral (SF6) anya shapes hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi. Exam point: 5 bond jode wale molecule ka shape trigonal bipyramidal hota hai, jaise PCl5 (phosphorus ka octet bhi fail hota hai - extended octet).

qe: The 'Bond Order' of a molecule with 10 bonding electrons and 6 antibonding electrons is:
qh: 10 आबंधी और 6 प्रति-आबंधी इलेक्ट्रॉनों वाले अणु का 'बंध क्रम' क्या होगा?
e: Bond order ka sutra hai (bonding electron - antibonding electron) / 2; is prashn mein 10 bandhan electron aur 6 prati-bandhan electron diye hain, isliye bond order = (10 - 6) / 2 = 2 nikalta hai - matlab ye ek double bond wala molecule hai, jaisa CN- ya O2 jaisi species mein milta hai. Bond order 3 hoti to N2 jaisa triple bond hota aur 1 hoti to single bond. Isliye 4, 3 ya 16 jaise aankde ganit se match nahi karte (16 to electron ki kul sankhya hai, bond order nahi). Exam point: bond order = (bonding - antibonding) / 2; 10 aur 6 electron wale molecule ki bond order 2 (double bond) hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Hybridization' of Nitrogen in Ammonia ($NH_3$)?
qh: अमोनिया ($NH_3$) में नाइट्रोजन का 'संकरण' क्या होता है?
e: Ammonia (NH3) mein nitrogen ke paas 5 valence electron hote hain - teen hydrogen ke saath teen bond banane ke baad ek akela joda (lone pair) bachta hai; isliye chaaron jode ko door-door rakhne ke liye nitrogen ek 2s aur teen 2p orbital milakar chaar sp3 hybrid orbital banata hai (ek lone pair aur teen bond jode). Isi sp3 hybridisation ke karan shape trigonal pyramidal banta hai (angle 107 degree). sp2 hota to samtal (planar) hota aur sp hota to linear - isliye wo vikalp NH3 ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: NH3 mein nitrogen ka hybridisation sp3 hota hai (chaar electron jode), isliye shape trigonal pyramidal aur bond angle 107 degree hota hai.

qe: Which type of bond is present in 'Solid Iodine' ($I_2$)?
qh: 'ठोस आयोडीन' ($I_2$) के अणुओं के बीच किस प्रकार का बल उपस्थित होता है?
e: Solid iodine (I2) mein iodine ke do atom ke beech covalent bond hota hai, par alag-alag I2 molecules ke beech keval van der Waals bal (instantaneous dipole se) lagte hain - isi karan iodine kam tapman par pighalta hai (114 degree C) aur ushe halka garam karne par seedha bhaap ban jaati hai (sublimation). Ionic ya covalent network bond hota to galaank bahut adhik hota. Isliye 'solid iodine' ka bond van der Waals hi kehlaata hai. Exam point: solid iodine (I2) ke molecules ko van der Waals bal jode rakhte hain (molecule ke andar covalent bond, molecules ke beech durbal aakarshan).

qe: Which molecule has 'sp' hybridization and a 'Linear' shape?
qh: किस अणु में 'sp' संकरण और 'रेखीय' आकृति होती है?
e: CO2 mein carbon sp hybridised hota hai (do sigma bond ke liye ek 2s aur ek 2p milte hain) aur dono oxygen atom ek doosre ke bilkul ulte taraf hote hain, isliye shape linear aur bond angle 180 degree hota hai. Isi karan CO2 non-polar hota hai (dono dipole kaat jaate hain). BeCl2 bhi sp wala linear hai, par yahan prashn CO2 ki hybrdisation ke liye hai; CH4 sp3 (tetrahedral) aur BF3 sp2 (trigonal planar) hote hain - isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi. Exam point: sp hybridisation + linear shape ka aam udaharan CO2 hai (BeCl2 aur C2H2 bhi sp wale hain), jisme bond angle 180 degree hota hai.

qe: Which bond is formed by the 'Lateral' (sideways) overlap of p-orbitals?
qh: p-कक्षकों के 'पार्श्विक' (sideways) अतिव्यापन से कौन सा बंध बनता है?
e: Pi bond tab banta hai jab do atom ke p-orbital aapas mein baaju se (lateral/parallel) overlap karein - isse electron ghanatva bond ke upar aur neeche (do taraf) hoti hai, isliye pi bond sigma bond se kamzor hota hai aur molecule uske around ghoom (rotate) nahi sakta. Sigma bond aam taur par head-on (siro-jaar) overlap se banta hai aur sabse prabal hota hai. Isi karan double bond = 1 sigma + 1 pi aur triple bond = 1 sigma + 2 pi hota hai. Exam point: p-orbital ke baaju (lateral) overlap se pi bond banta hai; ye sigma se kamzor hota hai par double/triple bond ka hissa hota hai (rotation rok deta hai).

qe: What is the shape of '$XeF_4$' (Xenon Tetrafluoride)?
qh: '$XeF_4$' (जीनॉन टेट्राफ्लोराइड) की आकृति कैसी होती है?
e: XeF4 mein xenon ke paas 4 bond jode (chaar fluorine ke saath) aur 2 akela jode hote hain; 6 electron jodon ki shape octahedral hoti hai, par do akela jode ek doosre ke bilkul ulte (upar-neeche) baithe hone ke karan baaki chaar fluorine ek hi samtal (plane) mein 90 degree par reh jaate hain - isliye shape 'square planar' kehlaata hai. Isi karan ye dhanaveshi (positive) aur udasin (neutral) ban jaata hai. Tetrahedral, trigonal bipyramidal aur octahedral anya jodon ke shape hain. Exam point: 4 bond jode + 2 akela jode = square planar shape, jaise XeF4 (xenon ka hybridisation sp3d2).

qe: The 'Bond Angle' in Methane ($CH_4$) is exactly:
qh: मीथेन ($CH_4$) में 'बंध कोण' का मान कितना होता है?
e: Methane ke carbon ka hybridisation sp3 hai, isliye uske chaar bandhan ek tetrahedron ke kono ki or nikalte hain aur har do bond ke beech ka kon lagbhag 109 degree 28 minute (109.5 degree) hota hai; yahi CH4 (aur poore sp3 molecule) ka nishchit bond angle hai. 120 degree sp2 ka, 180 degree sp ka aur 104.5 degree paani ke bent molecule ka hota hai, isliye wo aankde CH4 ke liye sahi nahi. Isi samaan aakaar ke karan methane ka dipole moment zero hota hai. Exam point: CH4 ka bond angle 109 degree 28 minute (109.5 degree) hota hai, kyunki carbon sp3 hybridised ho kar tetrahedral shape banata hai.

qe: According to Molecular Orbital Theory, which of the following is 'Paramagnetic'?
qh: आणविक कक्षक सिद्धांत के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'अनुचुंबकीय' (Paramagnetic) है?
e: Molecular Orbital Theory ke anusar O2 ke do pi-prati-bandhan (antibonding) orbital mein jode-bina (unpaired) electron paaye jaate hain, isliye O2 paramagnetic hota hai (drav oxygen chumbak ke paas chipak jaati hai). N2, CO2 aur H2 ke saare electron jode mein hote hain, isliye wo diamagnetic (prati-chumbakiya) hain - ye mot ke anusar hi tay hota hai, valence bond theory se nahi. Isliye is prashn ka sahi jod O2 hai. Exam point: MOT ke anusar O2 paramagnetic hai (pi antibonding mein do unpaired electron); N2 aur H2 ke saare electron paired hone se wo diamagnetic hain.

qe: What is the 'Bond Order' of the Neon molecule ($Ne_2$)?
qh: नियॉन अणु ($Ne_2$) का 'बंध क्रम' कितना होता है?
e: Neon (Ne2) ke do atom milkar bond nahi bana paate, kyunki neon ek nishkriya (noble) gas hai aur uske bahari kosh mein 8 electron already bhare hue hote hain - yani uske paas na dene wala electron hai na lene ki jagah. Isliye Ne2 ke bandhan (bonding) aur prati-bandhan (antibonding) electron barabar ho jaate hain aur bond order = (8 - 8)/2 = 0 nikalta hai, matlab bandhan hi nahi banta. Isi karan neon monoatomic gas ki tarah rehti hai, N2 ya O2 ki tarah dwiparmaanvik (diatomic) nahi banti. Exam point: Ne2 ki bond order 0 hoti hai - isliye neon gas ek atom ke roop mein rehti hai; salute-wale noble gases mein bond nahi banta.

qe: Which molecule has a 'Trigonal Planar' shape?
qh: किस अणु की आकृति 'त्रिकोणीय समतलीय' (Trigonal Planar) होती है?
e: BF3 ka aakaar samtal (trigonal planar) hai kyunki boron ke chaaron taraf sirf teen electron jode hote hain aur unme akela joda shamil nahi; teen jode ek doosre se barabar door rehne ke liye 120 degree par phail jaate hain. Isi samtalata ke karan BF3 ek flat (plane) molecule hai, jabki tetrahedral shape wale CH4 mein chaar bandhan teen-aayami roop mein hote hain. Bent aur octahedral aakaar yahan lagu nahi hote. Exam point: BF3 ka shape trigonal planar hota hai (teen bond jode, koi akela joda nahi, bond angle 120 degree).

qe: What is the 'Dipole Moment' of a symmetrical molecule like $CH_4$ or $CCl_4$?
qh: $CH_4$ या $CCl_4$ जैसे सममित अणुओं का 'द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण' क्या होता है?
e: CH4 aur CCl4 ke chaaron bandhan ka dipole ek saman hota hai; kyunki aakaar saman (symmetric) hai, chaaron dipole ke vector aapas mein jud kar ek doosre ko nishkriya kar dete hain - isliye inka net dipole moment shunya hota hai. Yahi baat CO2 aur SF6 jaise saman aakaar wale molecule mein bhi lagti hai; isi karan wo non-polar hote hain, halanki unke bandhan polar hote hain. NH3, H2O aur HCl jaisa asaman aakaar hone par dipole shunya nahi hota, isliye wo polar hote hain. Exam point: saman aakaar wale molecule (CH4, CCl4, CO2) ka net dipole moment shunya hota hai kyunki dipole vector ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain.

qe: The 'Bond Angle' in a Water molecule is reduced to 104.5° from 109.5° due to:
qh: जल के अणु में बंध कोण 109.5° से घटकर 104.5° किसके कारण हो जाता है?
e: Paani mein oxygen par do akela jode (lone pairs) hote hain aur teeno jodon ke vikarshan ka kram lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp hota hai; do akela jodon ke beech ka vikarshan sabse prabal hone ke karan wo H-O-H ke bond jodon ko thoda paas dhakel dete hain, isliye bond angle 109.5 se ghat kar 104.5 degree ho jaata hai. Yahi karan hai ki paani ka aakaar mudo (bent) rehta hai. Agar aisa dhakka na ho to molecule theek tetrahedral hota - jaise methane mein hota hai. Exam point: H2O ka bond angle 104.5 degree hota hai kyunki do akela jodon ka vikarshan prabal hota hai (lp-lp repulsion), jo bond angle ko 109.5 se kam kar deta hai.

qe: Which type of 'Hybridization' is present in $PCl_5$?
qh: $PCl_5$ अणु में किस प्रकार का 'संकरण' उपस्थित होता है?
e: PCl5 mein phosphorus ke paas 5 bond jode hote hain, isliye use 5 bandhan banane ke liye apne 3s, 3p aur ek 3d orbital ka istemal karna padta hai - ek 3s + teen 3p + ek 3d milkar paanch sp3d hybrid orbitals banate hain; isi se shape trigonal bipyramidal (120 degree aur 90 degree ke kon) banta hai. sp3d2 (6 jode, octahedral) tab hota hai jab 6 bond banein (jaise SF6), aur sp2/sp3 kam bond ke liye. Exam point: PCl5 mein phosphorus ka hybridisation sp3d hota hai - isliye phosphorus ka octet fail ho jaata hai (expanded octet) aur shape trigonal bipyramidal banta hai.

qe: What is the 'Geometry' of the $SF_4$ molecule?
qh: $SF_4$ अणु की 'ज्यामिति' कैसी होती है?
e: SF4 mein sulfur par chaar bandhan jode tatha ek akela joda hota hai; akela joda apni jagah gher kar ek fluorine atom ko hata deta hai, isliye molecule ka aakaar jhule (see-saw) jaisa lagta hai - do fluorine samtal mein aur do thode neeche-upar rehte hain. Isi liye sulfur ka hybridisation sp3d hota hai aur ye octet se adhik electron rakhta hai. Linear ya octahedral shape yahan nahi milti kyunki akela joda maujud hai. Exam point: SF4 ka aakaar see-saw hota hai (4 bond jode + 1 akela joda) - isliye ye PCl5 jaise poori trigonal bipyramidal shape nahi dikhata.

qe: The 'Bond Order' of $O_2^+$ is:
qh: $O_2^+$ आयन का 'बंध क्रम' क्या होता है?
e: O2 mein bond order 2 hoti hai; jab O2 se ek electron nikal kar O2+ ban jaata hai to wo electron ek prati-bandhan (antibonding) orbital se hatta hai, isliye prati-bandhan electron ghat jaate hain aur bond order 0.5 se badh jaati hai - (8 - 3)/2 = 2.5. Isliye O2+ ki bond order 2.5 hoti hai, jo O2 se adhik hai; isliye O2+ ka bond O2 se chhota aur mazbut hota hai. Bond order 3 (N2) aur 2 (O2) ke liye hoti hai, isliye wo aankde O2+ ke nahi hain. Exam point: O2+ ki bond order 2.5 hoti hai (O2 se adhik), kyunki electron nikalne par antibonding electron kam ho jaate hain.

qe: Which molecule has a 'Pyramidal' shape?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु की आकृति 'पिरामिडीय' (Pyramidal) होती है?
e: Ammonia ke nitrogen par teen hydrogen jurte hain aur ek akela joda bacha rehta hai; wahi akela joda nitrogen ko piramid ke shikhar par rakhta hai aur teen hydrogen uske aadhaar (base) mein - isliye iska aakaar pyramidal kehlata hai, bond angle lagbhag 107 degree. Yahi akela joda NH3 ko dhanayan donor bhi banata hai. Samtal (planar) shape hota to nitrogen aur teeno hydrogen ek hi tal mein hote, jo yahan nahi hota. Exam point: NH3 ka aakaar pyramidal (trigonal pyramidal) hota hai kyunki nitrogen par ek akela joda rehta hai (bond angle 107 degree).

qe: According to 'Fajan's Rules', which of the following favors high Covalent character in an Ionic bond?
qh: 'फाजान के नियम' के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कारक आयनिक बंध में उच्च सहसंयोजक लक्षण का समर्थन करता है?
e: Fajan's rules kehte hain ki agar dhanayan (cation) chhota ho aur rinayan (anion) bada ho, to dhanayan rinayan ke electron badal (electron cloud) ko apni or khinch leta hai - isse aaynik bond mein kuchh saanjhedari aa jaati hai yani covalent gun badh jaata hai. Aise hi ghanatva-yukt aavesh (jaise Al3+), 18-electron wala dhanayan aur bada-lachila rinayan covalentta badhate hain; isi karan chhoti dhatu ke lavan (jaise LiCl) NaCl se zyada covalent hote hain. 'Bada dhanayan aur chhota rinayan' ulta asar deta hai. Exam point: Fajan's rules ke anusar chhota cation + bada anion (polarisation adhik) ionic bond mein covalent gun badha dete hain.

qe: Which of the following compounds is the most 'Covalent' according to Fajan's rules?
qh: फाजान के नियम के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा यौगिक सबसे अधिक 'सहसंयोजक' है?
e: Li+ ion ka aakaar sabse chhota hota hai (kyunki lithium ka aayatan dhatu-samuh mein sabse kam hota hai), isliye wo chloride ke electron badal ko bahut prabal tarike se apni or khinch (polarise) leta hai - natija: LiCl mein ionic bond ka covalent gun Na+, K+ ya Rb+ wale chloride se zyada hota hai. Isi karan LiCl paani ke alawa organic solvent (jaise ethanol/acetone) mein bhi aasaani se ghul jaata hai, jabki NaCl nahi. R bada cation (Cs+) hone par polarisation kam hoti hai, isliye wo zyada ionic hota hai. Exam point: Fajan's rules ke hisab se LiCl sabse zyada covalent hai kyunki Li+ sabse chhota cation (polarising power adhik) hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Formal Charge' on the central Oxygen atom in an Ozone ($O_3$) molecule?
qh: ओजोन ($O_3$) अणु में केंद्रीय ऑक्सीजन परमाणु पर 'फॉर्मल आवेश' कितना होता है?
e: Ozone (O3) mein teen oxygen atom hote hain - beech wale oxygen ke do bond banate hain (ek single aur ek double jaisa roop) aur uske paas 2 akela joda rehta hai; formal charge ke hisab se beech wala oxygen +1 aur dono kinare wale oxygen alag-alag 0 aur -1 dikhate hain. Ye aavesh ka batwara hi ozone ki resonance (asthir) sanrachna batata hai. Isliye formal charge se hum ye nishchit karte hain ki kaun si Lewis sanrachna sabse sthir hai (jitne kam formal charge utni achhi sanrachna). Exam point: ozone mein kendra (central) oxygen ka formal charge +1 hota hai; isi se O3 ki resonance sanrachna samajh aati hai.

qe: Which type of 'Hydrogen Bond' is present in o-Nitrophenol?
qh: o-नाइट्रोफिनॉल में किस प्रकार का 'हाइड्रोजन बंध' उपस्थित होता है?
e: o-Nitrophenol mein nitro (NO2) aur hydroxyl (OH) samuh ek doosre ke bahut nazdeek (ortho sthaan par) hote hain, isliye OH ka hydrogen usi molecule ke NO2 ke oxygen se jud jaata hai - isi ko antarmukhi (intramolecular) hydrogen bond kehte hain, jo ek hi molecule ke andar banta hai. Iske ulat, p-nitrophenol mein dono samuh door hone ke karan do alag molecule judte hain, isliye wahan antarmolekuliya (intermolecular) bond hota hai. Isi karan o-nitrophenol ka kvathank kam aur wo steam-distillation se alag kiya ja sakta hai. Exam point: o-nitrophenol mein intramolecular (andarmukhi) hydrogen bond hota hai, kyunki OH aur NO2 ek hi molecule mein paas-paas hote hain.

qe: Why is 'Ice' less dense than 'Water'?
qh: 'बर्फ' का घनत्व 'जल' से कम क्यों होता है?
o: Due to an open cage-like structure formed by Hydrogen bonding
e: Paani ke molecule hydrogen bond ke karan barf mein ek khula pinjara (open cage) jaisa dhancha bana lete hain - har oxygen chaar hydrogen se ghira hota hai; is khuli sanrachna mein bahut khaali jagah (voids) bach jaati hai, isliye barf ka ghantva (density) paani se kam hota hai aur wo paani par tairta hai. Isi karan pighalne par ye khula dhancha toot kar molecule paas aa jaate hain aur paani 4 degree C par sabse ghana ho jaata hai. Ionic/metallic bonding ya CO2 ke karan barf halki nahi hoti. Exam point: barf paani se halki hoti hai kyunki usmein hydrogen bond se khula pinjara (cage) ban jaata hai; isliye barf paani par tairti hai aur paani 4 degree C par sabse ghana hota hai.

qe: Which of the following has the highest 'Lattice Energy'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसकी 'जालीदार ऊर्जा' (Lattice Energy) सबसे अधिक है?
e: Lattice energy aaynik thos padarth ko gaseous ionon mein todne ke liye chahiye urja hai; ye aavesh (charge) ke gunaank ke samanupati aur ion ke aakaar (size) ke vyutkram anupati hoti hai - matlab chhote ion aur badi aavesh wale jode ki lattice energy zyada hoti hai. NaF mein Na+ aur F- dono chhote hote hain, isliye law ke bhitar diye gaye jodon (NaCl, KBr, KCl) se iski lattice energy sabse adhik hoti hai (isliye NaF paani mein kam ghulta hai). Isi liye MgO jaise +2/-2 aavesh wale padarth ki lattice energy sabse zyada hoti hai. Exam point: lattice energy aavesh (charge) badhne aur ion ka aakaar ghatne par badhti hai - isliye chhote-chhote ion wale NaF ki lattice energy sabse adhik hoti hai.

qe: The 'Dipole Moment' of $NH_3$ is higher than $NF_3$ because:
qh: $NH_3$ का 'द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण' $NF_3$ से अधिक क्यों होता है?
o: Nitrogen is more electronegative than Fluorine
In $NH_3$, the orbital dipole and bond dipoles are in the same direction
e: NH3 mein nitrogen ke paas ek akela joda (lone pair) hota hai aur N-H bond ke dipole bhi nitrogen ki taraf jhukte hain; akela jode ka orbital dipole bhi usi disha mein hota hai, isliye dono ek doosre ko badhaate hain aur NH3 ka dipole moment lagbhag 1.47 D dikhta hai. NF3 mein fluorine nitrogen se adhik vidyut-rinaatmak hota hai, isliye N-F bond ke dipole bahar (fluorine ki or) jhukte hain aur akela jode ka dipole andar - dono ek doosre ko kaat dete hain, isliye NF3 ka dipole moment kam (0.24 D) reh jaata hai. Exam point: NH3 ka dipole moment NF3 se zyada hota hai kyunki usme akela jode ka dipole aur bond dipoles ek hi disha mein hote hain (NF3 mein wo kaat jaate hain).

qe: Which 'Bond' is formed by the overlapping of an s-orbital and a p-orbital?
qh: एक s-कक्षक और एक p-कक्षक के अतिव्यापन से कौन सा 'बंध' बनता है?
e: s-orbital gol (sphere jaisa) hota hai aur uski disha nishchit nahi hoti; jab ye p-orbital (jo ek disha mein phaila hota hai) ke saath siro-jaar (head-on) overlap karta hai, to bandhan ke dhrub (nuclei) ke beech electron ghanatva banti hai - ise s-p sigma bond kehte hain, jaise HF ya HCl mein H ka 1s aur halogen ka p orbital milkar bond banate hain. Sigma bond keval head-on overlap se banta hai, chahe wo s-s, s-p ya p-p ho; pi bond tab banta hai jab p-orbital baaju se (lateral) overlap karein. Exam point: s-orbital aur p-orbital ke head-on overlap se s-p sigma bond banta hai - jaise HCl aur HF mein hydrogen ke 1s aur halogen ke p orbital ke beech.

qe: Which of the following is 'Diamagnetic'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'प्रतिचुंबकीय' (Diamagnetic) है?
e: N2 ke saare electron jode (paired) mein hote hain - Molecular Orbital Theory ke anusar iske koi ayugm (unpaired) electron nahi bante, isliye ye chumbakiya kshetra se halka dhakel diya jaata hai aur diamagnetic (prati-chumbakiya) kehlata hai. Isi tarah C2, H2 aur CO2 bhi diamagnetic hote hain, jabki O2 aur NO mein unpaired electron hone ke karan wo paramagnetic hote hain. Isliye 'diamagnetic' ka sahi jod N2 hai. Exam point: N2 diamagnetic hai kyunki uske saare electron jode mein hain (koi unpaired electron nahi); O2 paramagnetic hai kyunki uske antibonding orbital mein 2 unpaired electron hote hain.

qe: The 'Bond Angle' in $NH_3$ is roughly:
qh: $NH_3$ में 'बंध कोण' लगभग कितना होता है?
e: Ammonia mein ek akela joda bond jodon se zyada jagah gherta hai, isliye bandhon ko thoda andar dhakel deta hai aur H-N-H ka kon adarsh 109.5 degree se ghat kar lagbhag 107 degree reh jaata hai. Yahi 107 degree ka aankda tatha pyramidal shape NH3 ki pehchaan hai. H2O mein do akela jode hone ke karan kon aur bhi kam (104.5 degree) hota hai, jabki CH4 mein akela joda nahi hone se 109.5 degree poora rehta hai. Exam point: NH3 ka bond angle lagbhag 107 degree hota hai kyunki akela joda bond jodon ke kon ko dabav deta hai.

qe: What is the hybridization of Carbon in 'Diamond'?
qh: 'हीरा' (Diamond) में कार्बन का संकरण क्या होता है?
e: Heere (diamond) mein har carbon atom apne chaar padosi carbon ke saath chaar sigma bond banata hai - iske liye carbon ke chaar orbital (ek 2s aur teen 2p) milkar chaar barabar sp3 hybrid orbitals banate hain, isliye har bond 109.5 degree par hota hai aur teen-aayami (3D) dhancha (tetrahedral network) banta hai. Yahi prabal network heere ki atyant kathorta (mohs 10) ka karan hai. Graphite mein sp2 aur fullerene mein bhi sp2 hota hai, isliye wo vikalp heere ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: heere ke carbon ka hybridisation sp3 hota hai (chaar sigma bond, 109.5 degree, tetrahedral network) - isi se heera sabse kathor padarth banta hai.

qe: Which force is responsible for the 'Viscosity' of liquids like Honey?
qh: शहद जैसे द्रवों की 'श्यानता' (Viscosity) के लिए कौन सा बल उत्तरदायी होता है?
e: Shahad (honey) jaisi drav padarth ki ghanata (viscosity) uske molecule ke beech lage aakarshan balon par nirbhar karti hai - honey mein glucose aur fructose ke bahut se OH samuh hote hain jo bahut zyada hydrogen bond banate hain, isliye paratein ek doosre ke upar sarak nahi paati aur drav gaadha lagta hai. Isliye garm karne par hydrogen bond toote jaate hain aur viscosity ghat jaati hai. Ionic bond ya covalent bond drav ke andar nahi, padarth ke bhitar hote hain - isliye wo vikalp iska kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: madhu jaisi drav dravaon ki viscosity antarmolekuliya balon (khaas kar hydrogen bond) se badhti hai; garam karne par ye ghat jaati hai.

qe: The 'Bond Order' of $N_2^+$ is:
qh: $N_2^+$ का 'बंध क्रम' कितना होता है?
e: N2 ke saare 10 valence electron bonding (aur thode antibonding) orbital mein hote hain jinme se ek electron nikalne par wo pehle pi-bonding (ya sigma) orbital se hatta hai; is se bonding electron ek kam ho jaate hain par antibonding wahi rehte hain, isliye bond order 3 se ghat kar (9 - 4)/2 = 2.5 ho jaati hai. Isliye N2+ ki bond order 3 se kam hoti hai, matlab N2+ mein bandhan N2 se kamzor ho jaata hai. O2+ ka mamla ulta hai (electron antibonding se hatta hai), isliye wahan bond order badhti hai. Exam point: N2+ ki bond order 2.5 hoti hai (N2 se kam), kyunki electron bonding orbital se nikalta hai.

qe: Which molecule is 'Linear'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अणु 'रेखीय' (Linear) है?
e: BeCl2 mein beryllium ke paas do hi valence electron hote hain, isliye wo do bond banane ke liye sp hybrid orbitals istemal karta hai - sp hybridisation ka swabhav linear (180 degree) hota hai, isliye dono chlorine atom bilkul ulte dishaon mein baith jaate hain. Isi karan BeCl2 vapour avastha mein linear hota hai aur iska dipole moment zero rehta hai. Bent (paani), trigonal (BF3) ya tetrahedral (CH4) aakaar yahan lagu nahi hote kyunki beryllium par koi akela joda nahi hai. Exam point: BeCl2 linear hota hai (sp hybridisation, 180 degree) kyunki beryllium ke paas do hi valence electron aur koi akela joda nahi hota.

qe: Which of the following molecules has a 'Square Pyramidal' geometry according to VSEPR theory?
qh: VSEPR सिद्धांत के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु की ज्यामिति 'वर्ग पिरामिडीय' होती है?
e: BrF5 mein bromine ke chaaron taraf paanch fluorine aur ek akela joda hota hai; chhah jodon ka aadhaar-aakaar octahedral hai, par akela joda ek kone se fluorine ko hata deta hai, isliye molecule vargiya piramid (square pyramidal) ban jaata hai. Isi karan isme ek akela joda samtal se bahar rehta hai aur chaar fluorine samtal mein. Trigonal bipyramidal ya see-saw aakaar yahan nahi bante. Exam point: BrF5 ka aakaar square pyramidal hota hai (5 bond jode + 1 akela joda, sp3d2 hybridisation).

qe: What is the 'Bond Order' of the He2+ ion?
qh: He2+ आयन का 'बंध क्रम' कितना होता है?
e: He2+ ion mein do electron hote hain - ek bonding orbital (sigma 1s) mein aur ek prati-bandhan (sigma* 1s) mein, isliye bond order = (2 - 1)/2 = 0.5 nikalta hai. Itni kam bond order ke karan ye ion bahut hi asthir hota hai aur sirf khaas avasthaoN (electric discharge ke dauraan) mein kuchh samay ke liye dikhai deta hai. He2 ki bond order zero hoti hai (isliye helium gas diatomic nahi banti), aur H2 ki 1 hoti hai - isliye wo aankde He2+ ke nahi hain. Exam point: He2+ ki bond order 0.5 hoti hai (ek bonding aur ek antibonding electron) - isliye ye bahut asthir ion hai.

qe: What is the 'Hybridization' of Carbon in a Carbonate ion (CO3 2-)?
qh: कार्बोनेट आयन (CO3 2-) में कार्बन का 'संकरण' क्या होता है?
e: Carbonate ion mein carbon ke paas sirf teen oxygen hote hain, isliye teen sigma bandhan banane ke liye uske ek 2s aur do 2p orbital milkar teen sp2 sankar orbital banate hain - isliye ye ion samtal (planar) hota hai aur teeno C-O bandhan barabar lambai ke dikhte hain. Yahi resonance se carbonate ki sthirta bhi judti hai. Chaar jode hote (jaise CH4 mein) to sp3 hota, isliye wo vikalp carbonate ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: CO3 2- ion mein carbon sp2 hybridised hota hai (teen sigma bandhan, samtal shape, 120 degree kon).

qe: The 'Bond Angle' in the H2S molecule is approximately 92°. This small angle is explained by:
qh: H2S अणु में 'बंध कोण' लगभग 92° होता है। इस छोटे कोण की व्याख्या किसके द्वारा की जाती है?
e: H2S mein sulfur ke paas ek hi bandhan joda tatha do akela jode hote hain; sulfur apne bandhan ke liye shudh (pure) p-orbital istemal karta hai, isliye H-S-H ka kon 90 degree ke aas-paas (lagbhag 92 degree) reh jaata hai - yahi Drago's rule kehlati hai. Oxygen ke chhote aakaar ke karan paani hybridise hokar 104.5 degree de deta hai, par sulfur nahi karta. Isi karan H2S H2O se kam polar hota hai. Exam point: H2S mein kon lagbhag 92 degree hi rehta hai, kyunki sulfur pure p-orbital ke zariye hydrogen se judta hai (Drago's rule).

qe: Which of the following molecules has the highest 'Bond Dissociation Energy'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस अणु की 'बंध वियोजन ऊर्जा' उच्चतम होती है?
e: N2 mein do nitrogen atom ke beech triple bond hota hai jismein ek sigma aur do pi bond hote hain, isliye iski bond dissociation energy lagbhag 946 kJ/mol hoti hai - yeh diye gaye vikalpon mein sabse adhik hai. Isi prabal bandhan ke karan nitrogen gas ko tod kar ammonia banana bahut mushkil hota hai (Haber process mein uchch taap aur dabav chahiye) aur samanya paristhitiyon mein nitrogen lagbhag nishkriya rehti hai. O2 ka double bond (498 kJ/mol) aur H2 ka single bond (436 kJ/mol) isse kaafi kam hota hai. Exam point: N2 ki bond dissociation energy sabse adhik hoti hai kyunki usme triple bond (bond order 3) hota hai - isliye N2 bahut sthir aur nishkriya gas hai.

qe: According to the 'Octet Rule', which of the following is an 'Electron Deficient' compound?
qh: 'अष्टक नियम' के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'इलेक्ट्रॉन न्यून' यौगिक है?
e: BCl3 mein boron ke paas sirf 6 electron hote hain (teen B-Cl bond se), isliye uska octet poora nahi hota - aise padarth ko electron-n-yoon (electron deficient) compound kehte hain. Isi kami ke karan boron ek akela joda lene ke liye utsuk rehta hai, isliye BCl3 Lewis acid ki tarah vyavhaar karta hai (NH3 ya paani se jud jaata hai). Halogen wale anya compounds (CCl4) mein carbon ka octet poora hota hai, isliye wo electron deficient nahi hain. Exam point: BCl3 electron-deficient hai kyunki boron ke paas sirf 6 electron (teen bond) hote hain; isi karan wo Lewis acid hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Polar' molecule?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'ध्रुवीय' (Polar) अणु है?
e: NH3 ke molecule mein nitrogen bahut vidyut-rinaatmak hai aur uske paas akela joda bhi hota hai, isliye uske ek sira par thoda rinaavesh aur baaki hisse par dhanaavesh banta hai - yani ye ek polar molecule hai (dipole moment lagbhag 1.47 D). Isi karan ammonia paani mein bahut aasaani se ghul jaata hai aur H-bond banaata hai, tatha paani ke molecules ko aakarshit karta hai. N2, O2 aur CO2 saman (symmetric) hone ke karan non-polar hote hain; NH3 unmein nahi aata. Exam point: NH3 polar molecule hai kyunki uske N-H bond mein vidyut-rinaatmakta ka antar hai aur akela joda bhi hai - isliye wo paani mein aasaani se ghulta hai.

qe: The 'Bond Order' of Carbon Monoxide (CO) is:
qh: कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड (CO) का 'बंध क्रम' कितना होता है?
e: Carbon monoxide (CO) mein carbon aur oxygen ke beech triple bond hota hai (do pi aur ek sigma), isliye iski bond order 3 hoti hai - ise samajhne ke liye aksar kaha jaata hai ki CO aur N2 ke electron ki sankhya ek jaisi hai (iso-electronic), isliye dono ki bond order bhi ek hi hoti hai. Isi karan CO ki bond enthalpy bahut adhik hoti hai aur ye ek mazbut ligand bhi hai. CO2 mein bond order 2 hoti hai aur C-O single bond wale mein 1 - isliye wo aankde CO ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: carbon monoxide (CO) ki bond order 3 hoti hai (N2 jaisi, iso-electronic) - isliye CO ka bandhan bahut mazbut hota hai.

qe: What is the shape of a molecule with 2 bond pairs and 2 lone pairs (like H2O)?
qh: 2 बंध युग्म और 2 एकाकी युग्म वाले अणु (जैसे H2O) की आकृति कैसी होती है?
e: Paani ke oxygen par do bond jode (hydrogen ke saath) aur do akela jode hote hain; chaar jodon ka aadhaar-aakaar tetrahedral hota hai, par do akela jode atomon ko hata dete hain aur bachi hui shape mudi hui (bent ya V-shaped) ho jaati hai - bond angle 104.5 degree. Isliye paani ka aakaar kaise banta hai ye samajhne ke liye yahi joda (2 bond + 2 akela) ka niyam kaam aata hai. Linear (2 bond, 0 akela) aur pyramidal (3 bond + 1 akela) anya jodon ke roop hain - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: 2 bond jode + 2 akela jode wale molecule ka aakaar bent (V-shaped) hota hai - jaise H2O, bond angle 104.5 degree.

qe: Which 'Bond' has the highest directionality?
qh: किस 'बंध' में उच्चतम दिशात्मकता (Directionality) होती है?
e: Rasaayanik bandhan mein kuchh bandhan disha-nirpeksh (non-directional) hote hain - jaise ionic bond aur metallic bond, jisme ye zaroori nahi ki atom kisi nishchit disha mein hi juda ho; iske ulat covalent bond ek nishchit disha mein hi ban sakta hai, kyunki bonding orbital ki or nishchit hoti hai. Isi karan covalent padarth ke aakaar (geometry) nishchit hote hain (jaise CH4 tetrahedral) aur bandh ka kon bhi nishchit hota hai. Isliye sabse adhik directionality covalent bond mein milti hai. Exam point: covalent bond ki directionality sabse adhik hoti hai, kyunki orbital ki disha hi bandhan ki disha tay karti hai; ionic aur metallic bond disha-nirpeksh hote hain.

qe: The 'Resonance' in Benzene provides it with:
qh: बेंजीन में 'अनुनाद' (Resonance) इसे क्या प्रदान करता है?
e: Benzene (C6H6) mein har carbon sp2 hybridised hota hai aur chautha electron ek delocalised pi cloud banata hai; isi electron ke aapas mein phailne (resonance) ke karan benzene ki urja apne anuman (expected) se kam reh jaati hai - isi fark ko resonance energy (lagbhag 36 kcal/mol) kehte hain. Yahi karan hai ki benzene kuchh anya alkenes ki tarah aasaani se judta nahi aur 'aromatic' (sugandhiya) kehlata hai. Isliye 'kuchh nahi', 'kam sthirta' ya 'rangeen rang' wale kathan galat hain. Exam point: benzene mein resonance (delocalisation) se extra sthirta (resonance energy ~36 kcal/mol) milti hai - isliye wo aam double bond se kam kriyaasheel hota hai.

qe: Which type of bond is found in 'Dry Ice' (Solid CO2)?
qh: 'शुष्क बर्फ' (ठोस CO2) के अणुओं के बीच किस प्रकार का बंध पाया जाता है?
e: Shushk barf (dry ice) thos CO2 hai jisme molecule ke andar carbon-oxygen ke covalent bandhan hote hain, par alag-alag molecule ek doosre se sirf halke van der Waals aakarshan se jude rehte hain - isliye ye bina pighle seedha gas mein badal jaata hai (sublimation). Yahi kamzor aakarshan dry ice ko narm aur kam taap par vyavhaar karne wala banata hai. Ionic ya metallic jaise prabal bandhan hote to ye itne kam taap par nahi badalta, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: dry ice mein molecular (van der Waals) aakarshan hota hai - isi karan ye -78 degree C par seedha gas ban jaati hai.

qe: The 'Octet Rule' is not applicable to which element?
qh: 'अष्टक नियम' किस तत्व पर लागू नहीं होता है?
e: Octet rule ka matlab hai bahari kosh mein 8 electron - ye baat un tatvon par lagu nahi hoti jinka pehla kosh hi bharta hai. Hydrogen ke paas sirf 1 electron hota hai aur wo 2 electron (helium ka vinyas) pa kar hi pura ho jaata hai, isliye usme '2 ka niyam' chalta hai; helium bhi isi karan 2 par sthir hota hai. Baki bhaari tatva (C, N, O, F) octet hi paate hain, aur kuchh (P, S) octet se zyada bhi le lete hain. Exam point: octet rule hydrogen par lagu nahi hoti kyunki uske pehle kosh mein 2 electron bharne par hi wo sthir ho jaata hai.

qe: The 'Angle' in a perfectly Tetrahedral molecule is:
qh: एक पूर्णतः चतुष्फलकीय अणु में 'कोण' कितना होता है?
e: Tetrahedral molecule mein kendra ke chaaron taraf chaar barabar bond hote hain jo ek tetrahedron ke konon ki or jaate hain; is aakaar mein har do bond ke beech ka kon 109.5 degree (yani 109 degree 28 minute) hota hai - yahi adarsh (perfect) tetrahedral angle hai. Isi karan methane (CH4) aur CCl4 ke saare kon barabar hote hain. Agar ek joda (akela) badal jaaye to angle 107 (NH3) ya 104.5 (H2O) tak gir jaata hai - isliye 109.5 sirf aadarsh tetrahedral ke liye hai. Exam point: perfectly tetrahedral molecule ka bond angle 109.5 degree (109 degree 28 minute) hota hai, jaise CH4 aur CCl4 mein.

qe: Which bond is formed by the 'Head-on' overlap of atomic orbitals?
qh: परमाणु कक्षकों के 'अक्षीय' (Head-on) अतिव्यापन से कौन सा बंध बनता है?
e: Jab do orbital seedhi rekha par aamne-saamne (head-on) takraate hain to unka overlap best hota hai aur ek majboot sigma bandhan banta hai; isi karan single bandhan hamesha sigma hota hai aur bandhan ke around rotation bhi sambhav hota hai. Baaju se (lateral) p-orbital overlap hone par pi bandhan banta hai, jo kamzor hota hai par double ya triple bandhan ka hissa banta hai. Isliye head-on overlap se bane bandhan ko hi sigma kaha jaata hai. Exam point: head-on (siro-jaar) overlap se sigma bandhan banta hai - ye prabal hota hai aur molecule ki rotation ko rokta nahi.

qe: What is the 'Bond Order' of the Carbon Monoxide (CO) molecule?
qh: कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड (CO) अणु का 'बंध क्रम' कितना होता है?
e: Carbon monoxide (CO) mein electron ki kul sankhya 14 hoti hai, jo N2 ke barabar hai - isi karan dono mukhya roop se ek jaise (iso-electronic) hote hain aur dono mein triple bond (bond order 3) hota hai; CO ke isi mazbut bandhan ke karan ushe todkar CO2 banana kathin hota hai aur ye dhaatuon ke saath mazbut ligand (jaise metal carbonyl) banata hai. Isliye is prashn mein bhi bond order 3 hi sahi jod hai. O2 (2) aur N2 (3) alag species hain, isliye unke aankde CO par nahi lagte. Exam point: CO ki bond order 3 hoti hai (N2 ki tarah iso-electronic), isiliye ye ek sthir gaseous oxide hai.

qe: According to 'Fajan's Rules', a high positive charge on a cation increases its:
qh: 'फाजान के नियम' के अनुसार, धनायन पर उच्च धनावेश इसके किस लक्षण को बढ़ाता है?
e: Fajan's rules ke anusar cation par adhik dhanaavesh (positive charge) hone se uski rinayan ke electron-badal ko khinchne ki shakti badh jaati hai (polarising power); isse aaynik bandhan mein electron ka batwara badal jaata hai aur covalent gun badh jaata hai. Isi liye Al3+ wale lavan (AlCl3) NaCl se zyada covalent tatha kam galaank wale hote hain. Kam aavesh (Na+) mein ye asar kam hota hai, isliye wahan aaynik gun zyada rehta hai. Exam point: cation par adhik aavesh (charge) covalent gun ko badha deta hai, kyunki polarising power adhik hone se electron badal khinch jaata hai.

qe: Which type of 'Hybridization' is found in the Ethene ($C_2H_4$) molecule?
qh: एथीन ($C_2H_4$) अणु में किस प्रकार का 'संकरण' पाया जाता है?
e: Ethene (C2H4) mein carbon-carbon ke beech double bond hota hai - ismein ek sigma aur ek pi bond hota hai; dono carbon ke paas teen-tee sigma bond jode hote hain (do hydrogen ke saath aur ek carbon ke saath), isliye unke teen orbitals milkar teen sp2 hybrid orbitals banate hain aur molecule samtal (planar) ho jaata hai (bond angle lagbhag 120 degree). Isi karan ethene ka double bond aage badh kar polythene banaata hai (addition polymerisation). sp3 ethane mein aur sp ethyne mein hota hai, isliye wo vikalp ethene ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: ethene (C2H4) mein carbon ka hybridisation sp2 hota hai (samtal, 120 degree) - kyunki usme ek double bond hota hai.

qe: The 'Bond Angle' in a molecule of Ammonia ($NH_3$) is less than 109.5° because of:
qh: अमोनिया ($NH_3$) के अणु में बंध कोण 109.5° से कम किसके कारण होता है?
e: NH3 ke nitrogen par ek akela joda bond jodon ko dhakel deta hai, isliye H-N-H ka kon 109.5 degree se ghat kar 107 degree ke lagbhag aa jaata hai; isi vikarshan (lp-bp) ko is chhote kon ka kaaran maana jaata hai. Yahi akela joda NH3 ke pyramidal aakaar aur uske dhanayan (donor) swabhav ka bhi karan hai. Methane mein koi akela joda nahi hota, isliye wahan poora 109.5 degree milta hai, aur paani mein do akela jode hone se kon 104.5 degree tak gir jaata hai. Exam point: NH3 ka kon 109.5 se kam hota hai kyunki akela joda aur bandhan joda ke beech vikarshan (lp-bp repulsion) hota hai.

qe: Which molecule has 'Zero' dipole moment despite having polar bonds?
qh: ध्रुवीय बंध होने के बावजूद किस अणु का द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण 'शून्य' होता है?
e: BF3 ka aakaar samtal aur saman (symmetric) hai, isliye uske teen B-F bandhan ke dipole ek doosre ko poori tarah nishkriya kar dete hain aur net dipole moment shunya reh jaata hai, halanki har bandhan polar hai. Isi tarah CCl4 aur CO2 bhi shunya dipole wale hote hain kyunki unke aakaar saman hote hain. Asaman aakaar wale NH3 ya H2O ka dipole kabhi shunya nahi hota, kyunki unke dipole ek doosre ko kaat nahi paate. Exam point: BF3 ka net dipole moment shunya hai (saman aakaar ke karan), par uske B-F bandhan polar hote hain.

qe: Which 'Bond' is the longest in length?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'बंध' लंबाई में सबसे बड़ा होता है?
e: Carbon-carbon bond ki lambai bond order par nirbhar karti hai - C-C single bond (order 1) sabse lamba hota hai (lagbhag 154 pikometre), C=C double bond usse chhota (134 pm) aur C triple-bond C sabse chhota (120 pm) hota hai, kyunki zyada bond order se atom nazdeek khinch jaate hain. Isliye 'longest' ka sahi jod single bond (C-C) hai; C-H, C=C aur C triple-bond C isse chhote hote hain. Exam point: sabse lamba carbon bandhan = C-C single bond (~154 pm); bond order badhne par lambai ghatti hai (single > double > triple).

qe: Which of the following molecules is 'Diamagnetic' according to Molecular Orbital Theory?
qh: आणविक कक्षक सिद्धांत के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अणु 'प्रतिचुंबकीय' (Diamagnetic) है?
e: C2 ke saare electron jode (pairs) mein bhare hote hain - yani ek bhi unpaired electron nahi bachta, isliye ye paramagnetic nahi balki diamagnetic hota hai aur chumbak se halka dhakel diya jaata hai. Isi karan C2 gas avastha mein paaya jaane wala halka species hai, jiska bond order 2 hota hai. Jo species paramagnetic hoti hain (jaise O2 ya NO), unme kam se kam ek unpaired electron maujud hota hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: C2 diamagnetic hai kyunki uske sab electron jode mein hain; iske ulat O2 paramagnetic hota hai kyunki usme do unpaired electron bache rehte hain.

qe: What is the 'Bond Order' of the Nitrogen ($N_2$) molecule?
qh: नाइट्रोजन ($N_2$) अणु का 'बंध क्रम' कितना होता है?
e: N2 mein dono nitrogen ke kul 10 valence electron hote hain, jinse do bonding tatha do antibonding electron bharne ke baad bond order (8 - 2)/2 = 3 nikalta hai - yani ek sigma aur do pi bandhan ka triple bond. Itna adhik bond order hi nitrogen ke bandhan ko bahut mazbut tatha ushe lagbhag nishkriya banata hai. Iske ulat O2 ki bond order 2 aur F2 ki 1 hoti hai, isliye wo aankde nitrogen ke liye theek nahi. Exam point: N2 ki bond order 3 hoti hai (triple bond), isi karan nitrogen gas bahut sthir hai aur ushe todne ke liye uchch urja chahiye.

qe: Which type of bond involves the 'Sea of Electrons' model?
qh: किस प्रकार के बंध में 'इलेक्ट्रॉनों का समुद्र' (Sea of Electrons) मॉडल प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Metallic bond ka prastutit (model) 'electron samudra (sea)' wala hai - isme dhaatu ke dhanayan (cations) ek niyamit dhancha (lattice) mein baithe rehte hain aur unke valence electron poore padarth mein swatantra roop se ghoomte hain; is samuh ko electron samudra kehte hain. Isi karan dhaatuein bijli-garmi ki achhi chaalak hoti hain, chamakdar dikhti hain aur peeti (beaten) ja sakti hai. Ionic bond electron ke sthanantaran se aur covalent bond electron ke saanjhe se banta hai - isliye ye vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: metallic bond mein electron samudra (sea of electrons) ka model chalta hai, jo dhaatuon ki chaalakta aur lachilapan (malleability) ka karan hai.

qe: What is the 'Geometry' of a molecule with $sp^3d^2$ hybridization (e.g., $SF_6$)?
qh: $sp^3d^2$ संकरण वाले अणु (उदा. $SF_6$) की 'ज्यामिति' कैसी होती है?
e: SF6 mein sulfur ke chaaron taraf 6 bond jode (chaar fluorine ke saath) hote hain - 6 jodon ke liye sulfur ek 3s, teen 3p aur do 3d orbital milkar chhah sp3d2 hybrid orbitals banata hai, isliye saare bond octahedron ke kono ki taraf jaate hain aur shape octahedral (ashtaphalk) ban jaati hai (sabhi kon 90 degree). Isi karan SF6 ek sthir, gas-roop, non-polar molecule hota hai jo bijli ke insulation (SF6 circuit breaker) mein istemal hota hai. Trigonal bipyramidal (PCl5) aur square planar (XeF4) anya jodon ke aakaar hain. Exam point: sp3d2 hybridisation wale molecule (SF6) ka aakaar octahedral hota hai - isme 6 bond jode aur koi akela joda nahi hota.

qe: Which molecule has 'Bent' geometry due to two lone pairs on the central atom?
qh: केंद्रीय परमाणु पर दो एकाकी युग्म होने के कारण किस अणु की आकृति 'मुड़ी हुई' (Bent) होती है?
e: Paani ke kendra (oxygen) par do akela jode maujud hote hain jo bandhan jodon se prabal vikarshan karte hain; inhi ke karan H-O-H ka kon 109.5 se ghat kar 104.5 degree reh jaata hai aur molecule V jaisa mudo dikhaai deta hai. Yahi mudi hui shape paani ko polar banati hai aur uske kai khaas gun (uchch kvathank, solvent) ki jad hai. Ek hi akela joda hota to shape pyramidal hoti (jaise NH3), isliye do akela jode hi bent shape ka karan hain. Exam point: H2O ka bent aakaar dono akela jodon (two lone pairs) ke karan banta hai - isliye bond angle 104.5 degree aur molecule polar hota hai.

qe: Which force is the 'Strongest' among the following?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा बल सबसे 'मजबूत' होता है?
e: Covalent bond ko sabse prabal bal maana jaata hai kyunki isme do atom apne electron saanjha karke bahut adhik dosh (bond enthalpy lagbhag 150-900 kJ/mol) ke saath judte hain - isi karan heera (covalent network) sabse kathor padarth aur N2 ka bandhan todna bahut mushkil hota hai. Ionic bond bhi prabal hota hai (uska lattice energy), par ye ions ke aakarshan par tika hai aur paani jaise polar solvent mein toot jaata hai; hydrogen bond aur van der Waals bal to bahut durbal aakarshan hote hain. Exam point: diye gaye balon mein covalent bond sabse prabal hota hai (adhik bond enthalpy), jabki hydrogen bond aur van der Waals bal durbal hote hain.

qe: What is 'Formal Charge' used for in Lewis structures?
qh: लुईस संरचनाओं में 'फॉर्मल आवेश' का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Formal charge ka upyog ye janne ke liye hota hai ki kisi padarth ki kai Lewis sanrachnaoN mein se kaun si sabse sthir (upyukt) hai - jis sanrachna mein formal charge sabse kam ho (aadarsh roop mein shunya) tatha rin aavesh adhik vidyut-rinaatmak atom par ho, wahi chuni jaati hai. Isi tarah SO2, CO2 aur O3 ki sahi sanrachna tay hoti hai. Bond order ya galaank nikalne mein formal charge ka seedha upyog nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: formal charge se sabse sthir Lewis sanrachna chuni jaati hai (formal charge jitna kam, sanrachna utni achhi).

qe: A 'Coordinate Covalent Bond' is also known as a:
qh: 'उपसहसंयोजक बंध' को अन्य किस नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
e: Coordinate covalent bond mein electron joda sirf ek atom deta hai, isliye ise 'daan (donation)' wala bandhan kehte hain aur iska doosra naam 'dative bond' hai (jaise NH4+, H3O+ aur hydronium mein). Ismein donor ke paas akela joda hona chahiye aur acceptor ke paas khaali orbital. Baad mein is bandhan ka vyavhaar aam covalent bond jaisa hi ho jaata hai, isliye ise alag ginti nahi ki jaati. Ionic, metallic aur hydrogen bond iske doosre naam nahi hain - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: coordinate covalent bond ko hi dative bond kehte hain - ismein electron joda ek hi atom (donor) deta hai (jaise NH4+ mein).

qe: The number of 'Sigma' ($\sigma$) and 'Pi' ($\pi$) bonds in Ethyne ($C_2H_2$) are:
qh: एथाइन ($C_2H_2$) में 'सिग्मा' ($\sigma$) और 'पाई' ($\pi$) बंधों की संख्या कितनी होती है?
e: Ethyne (C2H2) mein dono carbon ke beech triple bond hota hai - usmein ek sigma aur do pi bond hote hain; sath hi har carbon ek hydrogen se judta hai, isliye do aur sigma bond. Is tarah H-C triple-bond C-H mein kul 3 sigma (ek C-C aur do C-H) aur 2 pi bond hote hain (kul 5 bond). Isi karan ethyne sp hybridised hota hai, linear (180 degree) hota hai aur uski lambai 120 pm hoti hai. Single bond wale ethane mein 7 sigma aur 0 pi hote hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: ethyne (C2H2) mein 3 sigma aur 2 pi bond hote hain, kyunki usme ek triple bond (1 sigma + 2 pi) aur do C-H sigma bond hote hain.

qe: What is the hybridization of Beryllium in Beryllium Chloride ($BeCl_2$)?
qh: बेरिलियम क्लोराइड ($BeCl_2$) में बेरिलियम का संकरण क्या होता है?
e: BeCl2 mein beryllium ke paas keval do electron hone ke karan dono bandhan ek hi seedhi rekha mein bante hain - iske liye ek 2s aur ek 2p orbital milkar do sp hybrid orbital banate hain, isliye shape linear tatha dipole moment shunya hota hai. Isi karan BeCl2 vapour mein do chlorine beryllium ke dono or hote hain (180 degree). Teeno ya chaar bandhan hote to sp2/sp3 hota, par yahan sirf do bandhan hain isliye sp hi sahi hai. Exam point: BeCl2 ke beryllium ka hybridisation sp hai - isliye ye linear (180 degree) aur shunya dipole wala molecule hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Mass Number' of an atom?
qh: किसी परमाणु की 'द्रव्यमान संख्या' क्या होती है?
e: Kisi bhi atom ka dravyaman kramank (mass number) uske nabhik (nucleus) mein maujood proton aur neutron ki kul sankhya hota hai (electron ka dravyaman bahut kam hone ke karan ginti mein nahi aata); jaise carbon-12 mein 6 proton aur 6 neutron milakar 12 hote hain. Isi liye mass number hamesha poora aankda hota hai aur parmaanu kramank (atomic number = proton) se alag hota hai. 'sirf proton', 'sirf neutron' ya 'proton aur electron' wale kathan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: mass number = proton + neutron ki sankhya (nucleus mein); atomic number sirf proton ki sankhya batata hai.

qe: What is the chemical formula of 'Heavy Water'?
qh: 'भारी जल' (Heavy Water) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Bhaari paani (heavy water) ka rasayanik formula D2O hai, jismein saadhaaran hydrogen (protium) ki jagah uske bhaari samsthiti deuterium (2H) ke do atom oxygen se jude hote hain. Isi karan iska ghantva normal paani se thoda zyada (1.11 g/mL) aur galaank bhi thoda adhik hota hai; aur iska istemal nuclear reactor mein moderator ke roop mein hota hai. H2O to aam paani hai, T2O tritium wala paani hota hai aur H2O2 hydrogen peroxide hai - isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: heavy water ka formula D2O hai (deuterium oxide) - ise nuclear reactor mein moderator ke roop mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is the pH value of human blood?
qh: मानव रक्त का pH मान क्या होता है?
e: Manav rakt (blood) ka pH lagbhag 7.4 hota hai - yani ye halka kshariya (basic) hota hai, isliye ise 'physiological pH' bhi kehte hain. Is pH ko sthir rakhne ke liye khoon mein carbonate-bicarbonate aur phosphate ka buffer system kaam karta hai (aur CO2 ki matara bhi lagaatar santulit rehti hai). pH 7 se thoda upar hone par bhi ye jeevan-rakhak (vital) hota hai - isse kam ho jaana (acidosis) ya zyada ho jaana (alkalosis) dono khatarnak hain. Isliye 7, 6.8 ya 8.0 jaise aankde blood ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: manav rakt ka pH lagbhag 7.4 hota hai (halka kshariya); ise buffer system sthir rakhta hai, isliye ye 7 se thoda upar hota hai.

qe: Which gas is used in fire extinguishers?
qh: अग्निशामक यंत्रों में किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aag bujhane wale yantra (fire extinguisher) mein carbon dioxide (CO2) bhara jaata hai - jab ise chhoda jaata hai to CO2 turant failti hai aur aag ko hawa (oxygen) se alag kar deti hai, sath hi uske faile hue bhaap (sublimation) se thandak bhi padti hai, par wo aag ko koi nuksan nahi pahunchati aur bijli (electrical) wali aag par bhi surakshit rehti hai. Isi karan electrical aag aur drav (liquid) aag ke liye CO2 extinguisher chuna jaata hai (paani wala niyam yahan nahi chalta). Nitrogen gas kuchh khaas yantron mein hoti hai par aam extinguisher mein CO2 hi hai. Exam point: fire extinguisher mein CO2 gas istemal hoti hai - ye aag ko oxygen se alag kar deti hai aur bijli wali aag par bhi surakshit rehti hai.

qe: Which element is common to all acids?
qh: सभी अम्लों में कौन सा तत्व सामान्य है?
e: Rasayan vigyaan mein saare acids ko ek baat samaan hoti hai - unmein hydrogen (H) hota hai jo paani mein ghulne par H+ ion (yani proton, asal mein hydronium) ke roop mein nikalta hai; isi karan acid ka swaad khatta hota hai aur neele litmus ko laal karta hai. Dhatu acid ke saath kriya karke hydrogen gas deti hai - yahi baat siddh karti hai ki acid mein H maujood hota hai. Oxygen, chlorine ya nitrogen saare acids mein samaan nahi hote (jaise HCl mein oxygen hi nahi hota) - isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: saare acids mein hydrogen (H) tattv samaan hota hai; ye paani mein H+ dete hain, jo unki pehchaan hai.

qe: Which non-metal remains liquid at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर कौन सी अधातु तरल अवस्था में रहती है?
e: Kamre ke taapman par bromine (Br2) ek drav padarth hota hai (gahra laal-bhoora rang) - ye ekmatr adhatu (non-metal) hai jo drav ke roop mein milti hai (para bhi drav hai, par wo dhatu hai). Iska galaank -7.2 degree C aur kvathank 58.8 degree C hota hai, isliye samanya paristhiti mein ye drav rehti hai aur asaani se vashp ban jaati hai (isi liye bromine ki botalen savdhani se dhaanpi jaati hain). Iodine thos, chlorine aur fluorine gas hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: kamre ke tapman par drav adhatu = bromine (Br2); baki halogens (F2, Cl2 gas aur I2 thos) is avastha mein nahi hain.

qe: Which mineral's excess in water leads to 'Liver Cirrhosis'?
qh: पानी में किस खनिज की अधिकता से 'लीवर सिरोसिस' होता है?
e: Paani mein loha (iron) ki adhik matara hone se shareer mein extra iron beri jama ho jaata hai, jisse liver ki koshikaayein ne chalti hain - ye avastha hemochromatosis ya iron overload kehlati hai, aur isi se liver cirrhosis (jigar ka sakht hona) ho jaata hai. Iron haemoglobin ke liye zaroori hai to ke liye zaroori hai, par adhik matara zeherila hoti hai, isliye WHO ne peene ke paani mein iron ki seema (lagbhag 0.3 mg/L) tay ki hai. Calcium, fluorine ya sodium ke liye ye asar nahi hota - unki adhikta se anya bimari hoti hai. Exam point: paani mein iron ki adhikta se liver cirrhosis (hemochromatosis) hota hai; isliye peene ke paani mein iron ki matara seemit rakhi jaati hai.

qe: Which mineral is highly essential for the formation and strength of bones?
qh: हड्डियों के निर्माण और मजबूती के लिए कौन सा खनिज अत्यधिक आवश्यक है?
e: Calcium (Ca) shareer ke liye sabse zaroori khaniz hai kyunki ye haddi (bone) ke khaak (mineral) hisse ka mukhya ghatak hai - lagbhag 99% calcium haddiyon aur daanton mein hi jama rehta hai, jahan ye calcium phosphate aur hydroxyapatite ke roop mein kathorta deta hai. Isi karan bachpan mein calcium ki kami se haddiyan kamzor reh jaati hain aur bade hone par osteomalacia/osteoporosis jaise rog ho jaate hain. Iron, zinc ya iodine haddi ke dhanche ke liye itne zaroori nahi (wo anya kamo ke liye chahiye). Exam point: haddiyon ke nirman aur mazbuti ke liye sabse zaroori khaniz = calcium (99% calcium haddi-daant mein calcium phosphate ke roop mein).

qe: Which element is found in 'Tapetum Lucidum' that makes animal eyes shine at night?
qh: 'टेपिटम ल्यूसिडम' में कौन सा तत्व पाया जाता है जो रात में जानवरों की आँखों को चमकदार बनाता है?
e: Kuchh jaanvaron (khaas kar billi, kutta, baghera) ki aankh mein 'tapetum lucidum' naam ki chamakdar parat hoti hai jisme zinc ka bhaag hota hai; ye parat raat ki halki roshni ko aankh ke andar paravartit (reflect) kar deti hai, jisse jaanvar andhere mein bhi dekh paate hain aur unki aankhen raat mein chamakti dikhti hain. Isliye is parat ko 'mirror' jaisa kaam karne wali aankh ka hissa kaha jaata hai. Iron, calcium ya iodine in aankhon ki chamak ke liye nahi jane jaate. Exam point: Tapetum lucidum (jaanvaron ki aankh ki chamakdar parat) mein zinc paya jaata hai, jo raat ki roshni ko paravartit karke andhere mein dekhne mein madad karta hai.

qe: Which mineral helps in regulating 'Blood Pressure' and its lack can cause muscle cramps?
qh: कौन सा खनिज 'रक्तचाप' को नियंत्रित करने में मदद करता है और इसकी कमी से मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव हो सकता है?
e: Sodium (Na) shareer ke drav santulan (fluid balance) aur rakta dabav (blood pressure) ko niyantrit karne wala mukhya ayank hai - ye koshikaon ke bahar ke drav mein sabse adhik matara mein milta hai aur paani ki matara tay karta hai. Iski kami hone par manspeshiyan (muscles) akad jaati hain aur cramp (kheench) padti hai; zyada matara par rakta dabav badh jaata hai. Iron ya calcium ke liye aise BP-cramp ka seedha sambandh nahi hota. Exam point: rakta dabav ko niyantrit karta hai aur kami par manspeshi mein kheench (cramps) paida karta hai = sodium (Na).

qe: The deficiency of which mineral leads to 'Goitre' (swelling in the neck)?
qh: किस खनिज की कमी से 'घेंघा' (गर्दन में सूजन) होता है?
e: Goitre (ghengra) thyroid gland ke bade hone ki avastha hai; is gland ko thyroxine banane ke liye iodine chahiye hota hai, aur iodine na milne par gland kaam karne ke liye khud badh jaata hai - isliye gale (neck) mein sujan dikhti hai. Iska ilaaj iodised namak (iodized salt) ke istemal se hota hai, isliye Bharat mein namak mein iodine milaya jaata hai. Loha ki ghati se khoon ki kami, calcium ki ghati se haddi kamzor aur zinc ki ghati se badh-vikas ruk jaata hai - in teeno ka gale ki sujan se koi seedha sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: ghengra (goitre) iodine ki kami se hota hai; iodine thyroid hormone (thyroxine) ka zaroori hissa hai.

qe: Which mineral is highly required for the strength of 'Bones and Teeth'?
qh: 'हड्डियों और दांतों' की मजबूती के लिए किस खनिज की अत्यधिक आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Daant aur hadi dono ka kathor hissa calcium phosphate se banta hai; calcium ke sath phosphorus tatha protein (collagen) milkar bone matrix ko mazbuti deta hai, isliye bachpan mein doodh-dahi jaise calcium-yukt bhojan se daant aur hadi dono achhi banti hain aur budhape mein inki kami na ho to khokhla-pan nahi aata. Isi liye calcium ka istemal daant ki mazbuti aur hadi ki ghanatva dono ke liye kaha jaata hai. Iron ya zinc daant ke dhanche ka hissa nahi hote. Exam point: daant aur hadi dono ki mazbuti ke liye calcium hi mukhya khaniz hai (calcium phosphate ke roop mein).

qe: The deficiency of which element leads to 'Anemia' (low hemoglobin)?
qh: किस तत्व की कमी से 'एनीमिया' (कम हीमोग्लोबिन) होता है?
e: Anemia (khoon ki kami) ka mukhya kaaran iron (loha) ki kami hai, kyunki hemoglobin ke 'heme' hisse mein iron hi oxygen ko bandhta hai - iron na ho to hemoglobin hi kam banta hai, isliye khoon oxygen kam le jaata hai aur thakaan, peelaapan tatha kamzori dikhti hai.
