Isi karan palak, gud, kale chane jaise iron-wale bhojan aur iron ki goliyaan di jaati hain. Iodine ki kami se goitre aur calcium ki kami se haddi ki samasya hoti hai - wo anemia ke kaaran nahi. Exam point: anemia (rakta-alpata) iron ki kami se hota hai, kyunki hemoglobin ke heme hisse mein iron oxygen vahan karta hai.

qe: Which mineral helps regulate the 'Heart Beat' and its imbalance can be fatal?
qh: कौन सा खनिज 'हृदय की धड़कन' को नियंत्रित करने में मदद करता है और इसका असंतुलन घातक हो सकता है?
e: Potassium (K) koshika ke andar ka mukhya dhanayan (cation) hai aur ye hriday ki dhadkan (heart beat) ko niyantrit karne wali vidyut-sanketa (electrical signal) banane mein seedha shamil hota hai - iski matara kam ya zyada hone par dil ki dhadkan aniyamit ho jaati hai aur jaan bhi ja sakti hai. Isi karan kele (banana), nariyal paani aur anya potassium-yukt bhojan hriday ke liye achhe maane jaate hain. Sodium koshika ke bahar ka ayank hai jo paani ka santulan dekhta hai, par dhadkan ki garbadi ka khaas khaniz potassium hi hai. Exam point: hriday ki dhadkan niyantrit karne wala khaniz = potassium; iski ghat-badh matara jaanleva ho sakti hai.

qe: Which element is needed in very 'small' (micro) amounts for the Thyroid gland?
qh: थायराइड ग्रंथि के लिए किस तत्व की बहुत 'कम' (सूक्ष्म) मात्रा में आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Thyroid gland ko iodine bahut hi kam matara (micro/trace amount) mein chahiye hota hai - prati din lagbhag 150 microgram; itni kam matara mein bhi ye hormone (thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine) ka aavashyak hissa hota hai. Isi karan iodine ko 'trace element' kaha jaata hai aur namak mein mikro matara mein mila diya jaata hai, taaki kami na ho. Calcium aur iron ki matara shareer mein isse kai guna adhik hoti hai, isliye wo micro elements nahi hain. Exam point: thyroid gland ke liye atyant kam (micro) matara mein chahiye = iodine; iski suchmatara ka bhi kami thyroxine ko rok deti hai.

qe: What is the chemical name of Vitamin A?
qh: विटामिन A का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Vitamin A ka rasayanik naam retinol hai (aur iske anya roop retinal tatha retinoic acid hote hain) - ye roshni ko aankh ke retina par pehchanne wale pigment (rhodopsin) ka hissa hai. Iski kami se 'raat ka andhapan' (night blindness) aur aankh ke kornea ki sukh-sambandhi samasya hoti hai; gajar, papita, doodh, ghee mein ye milta hai. Thiamine vitamin B1 ka, ascorbic acid vitamin C ka aur calciferol vitamin D ka rasayanik naam hai - isliye wo vitamin A ke sahi naam nahi hain. Exam point: Vitamin A ka rasayanik naam = retinol; iski kami se raat ka andhapan (night blindness) hota hai.

qe: Which mineral is a key component of Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)?
qh: विटामिन B12 (साइनोकोबालामीन) का मुख्य घटक कौन सा खनिज है?
e: Vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin) ke kendra (core) mein cobalt dhatu hoti hai - yahi iske naam 'cobal' ka kaaran hai; ye vitamin laal rang ka hota hai (jisme cobalt ke aas-paas corrin ring hoti hai). Ye DNA banane aur nerve-koshikaon ko swasth rakhne ke liye zaroori hai, aur iski kami se khaaliqdosh anemia tatha nerve ki samasya hoti hai. Iron, zinc aur iodine B12 ke dhanche ke hissa nahi hote - isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: Vitamin B12 ke dhanche mein maujud dhatu = cobalt, isi karan iska naam cyanocobalamin hai.

qe: Which type of 'Acid' is associated with Vitamin B9?
qh: विटामिन B9 के साथ कौन सा 'अम्ल' जुड़ा हुआ है?
e: Vitamin B9 ka aam naam folic acid hai (iska anya roop folate hota hai) - ye DNA tatha laal rakt-kan (RBC) banane ke liye zaroori hai; iski kami se anemia hota hai aur garbhavastha mein bachche ke reedh ki nali (neural tube) mein dosh aa sakta hai. Isi karan garbhvati mahilaon ko folic acid ki goli di jaati hai, aur hari sabziyaan (palak) iska achha srot hain. Ascorbic acid (C), retinol (A) aur thiamine (B1) anya vitamins ke naam hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Vitamin B9 = folic acid; iski kami anemia karti hai aur garbhavastha mein bachche mein neural tube defect ka khatra badhati hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT an organic substance?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक कार्बनिक पदार्थ 'नहीं' है?
e: Organic padarth wahi hote hain jinka aadhaar carbon ke bandhanon par hota hai - carbohydrate, protein, vitamin aur vasa (fats) sab organic hain kyunki inme carbon ki kadiyan hoti hain. Khanij (minerals) jaise calcium, iron, sodium aur paani inorganic hote hain, kyunki inme carbon nahi hota; isliye ye 'jeewan ke liye zaroori' hone par bhi organic nahi kehlaate. Isi karan rasayan vigyaan mein 'organic chemistry' carbon ke yaugikon ka adhyayan karti hai. Exam point: khaniz (minerals) organic padarth nahi hote - ye inorganic hain kyunki inme carbon ka dhancha nahi hota (water bhi inorganic hai).

qe: The chemical name of Vitamin B5 is ____.
qh: विटामिन B5 का रासायनिक नाम ____ है।
e: Vitamin B5 ka rasayanik naam pantothenic acid hai - ye sabhi janvaron aur paudhon mein paya jaata hai (isliye iska naam Greek shabd 'pantothen' se aaya, jiska matlab 'har jagah') aur ye coenzyme A ka hissa hokar khaane ko urja mein badalne tatha hormone banane mein madad karta hai. Iski kami se thakaan, bukhaar aur pair mein jhunjhuni ho sakti hai; anaaj, paali hui daal aur ande iska achha srot hain. Riboflavin (B2), thiamine (B1) aur biotin (B7) alag vitamins hain, isliye wo sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: Vitamin B5 ka rasayanik naam = pantothenic acid, jo coenzyme A ke roop mein khaane se urja nikalne mein madad karta hai.

qe: Which element's deficiency causes 'Goitre' (swelling of the neck)?
qh: किस तत्व की कमी से 'घेंघा' (गर्दन में सूजन) होता है?
e: Ghengra (goitre) thyroid gland ke bade hone ki bimari hai; ye tab hoti hai jab thyroid hormone banane ke liye iodine na mile, kyunki uske molecule mein iodine zaroori hai - isi karan gland ka kaam badhane ke liye khud sujan bani aati hai. Iske ilaaj ke liye iodised namak ka istemal kiya jaata hai aur samudri bhojan (fish, samundri sabziyaan) isme madad karte hain. Zinc ke bina bachche ka vikas ruk jaata hai aur loha ki ghati se khoon ki kami hoti hai - par ye dono gale ki sujan ke kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: thyroid ka bada hona (goitre/ghiengha) iodine tattv ki kami se hota hai.

qe: Which element is found in Protein that is absent in Carbohydrates and Fats?
qh: प्रोटीन में कौन सा तत्व पाया जाता है जो कार्बोहाइड्रेट और वसा में अनुपस्थित होता है?
e: Protein mein nitrogen tattv sammilit hota hai, kyunki protein ke chhotu ikai 'amino acid' mein amino samuh (NH2) maujud hota hai - carbohydrate aur vasa (fats) mein keval carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen hote hain, isliye wahan nitrogen nahi milta. Isi karan protein ketli (protein test) ke liye ulhe (burnt hair) ki gandh aati hai, jismein nitrogen wale yaugik bante hain; aur urine mein urea (mein nitrogen) shareer ke protein-tootne ka parinaam hota hai. Sulphur kuchh protein mein hota hai par uski upasthiti kam aam hai, aur phosphorus kahan hi milta hai. Exam point: protein mein nitrogen hota hai (amino group NH2 se) - carbohydrate aur vasa mein nitrogen nahi hota.

qe: Which element is found in Insulin that helps regulate sugar levels?
qh: इंसुलिन में कौन सा तत्व पाया जाता है जो शुगर लेवल को नियंत्रित करने में मदद करता है?
e: Insulin ek protein hormone hai jo pancreas banata hai aur khoon ki chini (glucose) ko koshikaon tak pahunchata hai; zinc iske molecule ko baaheN (abstraction) ke saath jodkar sthir rakhta hai aur ushe insulin assembly tatha bhandaran (storage) mein madad deta hai. Isi karan zinc ki kami se insulin ka nirman kam ho jaata hai aur shakkar ka niyantran bigad jaata hai (junior-level sawalon mein yahi baat poochhi jaati hai). Iron, calcium ya iodine insulin ke dhanche ka hissa nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi. Exam point: insulin mein zinc (Zn) dhatu maujud hoti hai, jo ushe sthir rakhti hai aur mithaas (sugar) niyantrit karne wale hormone mein madad karti hai.

qe: Which artificial substance is 500 times sweeter than sugar but provides no energy?
qh: कौन सा कृत्रिम पदार्थ चीनी से 500 गुना अधिक मीठा है लेकिन कोई ऊर्जा प्रदान नहीं करता?
e: Saccharin ek manav-nirmit mithaas wala padarth hai jo cheeni se lagbhag 300-500 guna adhik mitha hota hai par usme koi urja (calorie) nahi hoti, kyunki shareer ise pacha-kar urja mein nahi badal paata. Isiliye diabetes ke rogiyon aur vajan ghatane wale logon ke liye 'sugar-free' padarth mein iska istemal hota hai (ab isi tarah aspartame, sucralose bhi aate hain). Cheeni (sucrose) dravyaman mein mitha hoti hai par usse urja milti hai, isliye wo khaas jod nahi. Exam point: sugar se lagbhag 500 guna adhik mitha par zero-urja (kaalori-free) artificial mithaas = saccharin.

qe: What is the ratio of C, H, and O in a carbohydrate molecule like Glucose?
qh: ग्लूकोज जैसे कार्बोहाइड्रेट अणु में C, H और O का अनुपात क्या है?
e: Carbohydrate ke ek sutra-ikak (formula unit) mein carbon, hydrogen tatha oxygen ki sankhya ka sambandh 1:2:1 ke roop mein bayaan hota hai - yani har carbon ke saamne do hydrogen aur ek oxygen. Glucose (C6H12O6) iska saaf udaharan hai; isi anupat ki wajah se inhe carbon aur paani (hydrate) ka jod maan kar ye naam mila. Yahi anupat sucrose (C12H22O11) jaise dwi-sharkaron (disaccharides) mein thoda badal jaata hai kyunki wahan ek paani ka anu ghat jaata hai. Protein aur vasa mein ye anupat nahi hota (protein mein nitrogen bhi hota hai), isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: carbohydrate mein C:H:O = 1:2:1 hota hai (jaise glucose C6H12O6); yahi inki pehchaan hai.

qe: Which mineral is required to prevent 'Goitre' (Ghiengha) by the Thyroid gland?
qh: थायराइड ग्रंथि द्वारा 'घेंघा' को रोकने के लिए किस खनिज की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Thyroid hormone banane ke liye iodine ke tattv ki aavashyakta hoti hai; isi liye agar khaane-namak mein iodine na ho to hormone ka nirman ruk jaata hai aur thyroid gland bada hokar 'goitre' ya ghiengha bana deta hai. Iske bachaav ke liye Bharat sarkar ne namak mein iodine (iodisation) milana anivary kar diya hai aur iodised namak par 'goitre control' ka nishaan bhi lagta hai. Sodium ki adhikta se BP, calcium ki kami se haddi aur iron ki kami se anemia ka khatra hota hai - ye ghiengha nahi banate. Exam point: thyroid gland ko ghiengha (goitre) se bachaane ke liye iodine ki aavashyakta hoti hai - isi liye iodised namak istemal karte hain.

qe: Which component is missing in Inorganic substances like Water and Minerals?
qh: पानी और खनिजों जैसे अकार्बनिक पदार्थों में कौन सा घटक अनुपस्थित होता है?
e: Inorganic padarth jaise paani aur khaniz mein carbon ka tattv nahi hota; ye keval tattvon (elements) aur unke lavan ke roop mein hote hain, isliye inhe 'kaarban-rahit' (inorganic) kehte hain. Organic padarth (carbohydrate, protein, vitamin, vasa) sabhi mein carbon ki kadiyan hoti hain, isliye unme carbon zaroori ghatak hota hai. Yahi baat rasayan vigyaan mein bhi hai - carbon ki chemistry ko organic chemistry kaha jaata hai (jaise CO2 aur carbonate alag case hain). Exam point: paani aur khaniz jaise inorganic padarthon mein carbon (C) tattv nahi hota, isliye ye organic nahi kehlaate.

qe: Which element is a key component found in the structure of Insulin?
qh: इंसुलिन की संरचना में पाया जाने वाला मुख्य तत्व कौन सा है?
e: Insulin ke bhandaran aur uske sthir dhanche ke liye zinc dhatu zaroori hai - pancreases ki beta-koshikaon mein insulin zinc ke saath mil kar chhoti kristalein (hexamer) banata hai, jisse hormone sthir rehkar samay par nikalta hai. Isi karan zinc ki kami insulin ke nirman-nikaasi (secretion) ko kam kar deti hai, jisse khoon ki shakkar badhne lagti hai. Iron (hemoglobin ke liye) aur calcium (haddi ke liye) alag kaam karte hain, isliye wo vikalp insulin ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: insulin ke dhanche mein zinc maujud hota hai - zinc ki kami se insulin ka nirman-nikaasi kam ho jaata hai.

qe: The 'Table Sugar' used in our homes is chemically known as ____.
qh: हमारे घरों में उपयोग की जाने वाली 'टेबल शुगर' का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Ghar mein istemal hone wali shakkar (table sugar) ko rasayan mein sucrose kehte hain - ye glucose aur fructose ke judne se banti hai (C12H22O11) aur Ganna, chukandar (beet) iske mukhya srot hain. Pakaane par sucrose glucose aur fructose mein toot jaati hai, isliye mithai ka swaad badal jaata hai (inversion). Glucose monomer hai aur lactose doodh ki shakkar hai - isliye wo vikalp table sugar ke sahi naam nahi hain. Exam point: ghar ki cheeni (table sugar) ka rasayanik naam sucrose hai (glucose + fructose); ye ganne aur chukandar se milti hai.

qe: What is the ratio of Carbon, Hydrogen, and Oxygen in a typical Carbohydrate?
qh: एक सामान्य कार्बोहाइड्रेट में कार्बन, हाइड्रोजन और ऑक्सीजन का अनुपात क्या होता है?
e: Is anupat ka niyam yahi hai ki hydrogen ki sankhya carbon se dugni aur oxygen ki sankhya carbon ke barabar rahe; jaise C6H12O6 mein 6 carbon ke saamne 12 hydrogen aur 6 oxygen hote hain, jise chhota karke 1:2:1 likha jaata hai. Yahi anupat yahi batata hai ki 'carbohydrate' naam carbon ke hydrate se kyun pada; kuchh sharkarayen (jaise ribose) is anupat se alag bhi hoti hain, par aam carbohydrate ke liye 1:2:1 chalta hai. Nitrogen wale padarth protein hote hain, isliye wo vikalp carbohydrate ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: carbohydrate mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen ka anupat 1:2:1 hota hai - jaise glucose (C6H12O6) mein 6:12:6.

qe: Which element is found in Insulin?
qh: इंसुलिन में कौन सा तत्व पाया जाता है?
e: Insulin ke aavashyak tattv ke roop mein zinc ko jana jaata hai, kyunki zinc ion ke bina insulin ke chhah ikaiyan (hexamer) theek se nahi bandhti aur uska bhandaran mushkil ho jaata hai. Isi baat ko yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki insulin ek protein hormone hai par uske dhanche mein ek dhatu (zinc) bhi jude rehti hai - isliye kuchh prashnon mein 'element found in insulin' ka uttar zinc hota hai. Iron, calcium aur iodine wahan nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp insulin ke liye sahi jod nahi. Exam point: insulin ke dhanche mein maujud tattv = zinc (Zn), jo ushe sthir aur bhandaran-yogya banata hai.

qe: Which mineral is found in 'Tapetum Lucidum', making animal eyes shine?
qh: 'टेपिटम ल्यूसिडम' में कौन सा खनिज पाया जाता है, जिससे जानवरों की आँखें चमकती हैं?
e: Tapetum lucidum jaanvaron ki aankh ke peeche ki wo parat hai jo andar aayi roshni ko wapas paravartit karti hai; is parat ke dhanche mein zinc khaniz ka yogdaan hota hai, isliye bade raat ke shikaari jaanvaron ki aankhein andhere mein bhi kaam karti hain aur flash ya torch mein unki aankhen chamakte hue dikhti hain. Manushyon mein ye parat nahi hoti, isliye hamari aankhein aise nahi chamakti - isi antar se ye prashn banta hai. Iron, calcium ya iodine is parat ke liye aise nahi jane jaate. Exam point: Tapetum lucidum mein maujud khaniz = zinc, jo jaanvaron ki aankh ko chamakdar-paravartak banakar raat mein dekhne mein madad deta hai.

qe: The deficiency of which element can lead to reduced insulin production?
qh: किस तत्व की कमी से इंसुलिन उत्पादन कम हो सकता है?
e: Zinc ki kami se insulin ki banane-nikaasi ki kshamta ghat jaati hai, kyunki insulin ke hexamer dhanche ko zinc ion jodta hai - zinc na ho to hormone theek se nahi ban paata. Isliye zinc ki kami ko kam insulin tatha bigde shakkar (blood sugar) se jodkar padha jaata hai; iske ilawa zinc ghav bharne aur pratirodhak shakti (immunity) ke liye bhi zaroori hai. Iron ki kami se anemia hota hai aur iodine ki kami se thyroid badhta hai - ye insulin production ke liye seedha kaaran nahi hain. Exam point: insulin ke nirman mein kami (kam insulin banna) zinc ki kami se judi hoti hai, kyunki zinc insulin ko sthir karta hai.

qe: Which mineral level is regulated by the Adrenal gland (part of 4S)?
qh: एड्रिनल ग्रंथि (4S का हिस्सा) द्वारा किस खनिज के स्तर को नियंत्रित किया जाता है?
e: Adrenal gland shareer mein namak (salt/sodium) tatha paani ke santulan ko niyantrit karta hai - ye aldosterone jaise hormone chhodta hai jo gurde (kidney) se sodium ko wapas sokhne mein madad karta hai; isi karan use '4S' (salt, sugar, sex, stress) wale hormone wale samuh mein ginaya jaata hai. Isi baat ka seedha sambandh is prashn se hai ki adrenal gland dwara niyantrit khaniz = salt (namak). Calcium ya iron par adrenal ka aisa seedha niyantran nahi hota. Exam point: adrenal gland dwara niyantrit khaniz = salt (namak/sodium), kyunki aldosterone sodium ke santulan ko tay karta hai.

qe: Goitre (enlargement of the neck) is caused by the deficiency of which element?
qh: घेंघा (गर्दन का बढ़ना) किस तत्व की कमी के कारण होता है?
e: Gale (neck) mein thyroid gland ka bada hona goitre (ghiengha) kehlata hai; ye gland iodine ka istemal karke thyroxine banata hai, isliye iodine na milne par hormone banta hi nahi aur gland fail jaata hai. Isse bachne ke liye samudri namak-fish ka istemal tatha iodised namak ki salah di jaati hai. Zinc ki kami se badh-vikas ruk jaata hai aur iron ki kami se hemoglobin ghatta hai - ye dono goitre ke kaaran nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: gale mein sujan (goitre) iodine ki kami se hoti hai; thyroid hormone (thyroxine) ke aavashyak tattv iodine ka yahi sambandh hai.

qe: Which mineral is essentially required by the Thyroid gland to produce Thyroxine?
qh: थायरोक्सिन बनाने के लिए थायराइड ग्रंथि को किस खनिज की मुख्य रूप से आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Thyroid gland ko thyroxine banane ke liye iodine tattv chahiye - is hormone ke molecule mein iodine ke chaar tak atom hote hain, isliye iodine ke bina ye hormone ban hi nahi sakta. Isi karan thyroid gland iodine ko khoon se kheench leta hai (radioactive iodine scan isi gun ka fayda uthata hai). Calcium haddiyon ke liye, iron hemoglobin ke liye aur zinc insulin ke liye zaroori hain, par thyroxine ke liye sirf iodine chahiye. Exam point: thyroid gland ko thyroxine banane ke liye iodine zaroori hai; is tattv ki kami se goitre hota hai.

qe: Which element is crucial for the generation of electrical impulses in neurons?
qh: न्यूरॉन्स में विद्युत आवेगों के उत्पादन के लिए कौन सा तत्व महत्वपूर्ण है?
e: Sodium ion (Na+) koshika ke bahar atyadhik matara mein hota hai aur jab koi sanketa (signal) koshika tak pahunchta hai to sodium ion andar ghusta hai - isi vidyut-parivartan (depolarisation) se nerve impulse aage badhta hai. Isi karan sodium ko 'vidyut-sanketa ke liye zaroori tattv' kaha jaata hai, aur sodium-potassium pump (ion pump) nerve ke baahar-andar ke aavesh ko santulit rakhta hai. Iron ya calcium nerve impulse banane ka mukhya ayank nahi hain (calcium sanketa bhijne mein madad karta hai par Na+ ka aana mukhya hai). Exam point: nerve (neuron) mein vidyut-sanketa (impulse) paida karne ke liye mukhya tattv = sodium (Na+), kyunki iska koshika mein aana depolarisation karta hai.

qe: Which mineral is a key component of the 'Tapetum Lucidum' layer in animal eyes?
qh: जानवरों की आँखों की 'टेपिटम ल्यूसिडम' परत का मुख्य घटक कौन सा खनिज है?
e: Tapetum lucidum se jude jaanvaron (khaas kar raat mein shikaar karne wale) ki aankhon ke is hisse ka rasayanik tattv zinc hi hai - ye ek chandar-patal (shiny membrane) hai jo aankh mein aayi halki roshni ko doosri baar retina par bhejti hai, jisse unhe andhere mein saaf dikhta hai. Isi karan unki aankhen camera flash mein chamakte hui dikhti hain. Iron, calcium ya iodine ka is parat ke dhanche mein aisa seedha yogdaan nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Tapetum lucidum ki parat mein mukhya tattv = zinc (Zn); yahi parat raat mein jaanvaron ki aankh chamakti aur unhe dekhne mein madad karti hai.

qe: The chemical element found in 'Tapetum Lucidum' which makes animal eyes reflective is ____.
qh: 'टेपिटम ल्यूसिडम' में पाया जाने वाला वह रासायनिक तत्व जो जानवरों की आँखों को चमकदार बनाता है, ____ है।
e: Raat ke shikaari jaanvaron ki aankh ke peeche jo parat halki roshni ko paravartit karti hai, us parat ka nirmaan zinc-yaugikon par hota hai; isi karan unki aankhein andhere mein tatha flash mein chamakdar dikhti hain. Iske ulat manushyon mein tapetum lucidum nahi hota, isliye hamari aankhein aise nahi chamakti. Ye baat unhe 'night vision' deti hai, kyunki roshni ko do baar upyog kiya jaata hai. Exam point: jaanvaron ki aankh ko chamakdar-paravartak (reflective) banane wala tattv = zinc, jo tapetum lucidum ke dhanche mein paya jaata hai.

qe: Which chemical substance primarily forms Kidney Stones?
qh: किडनी की पथरी मुख्य रूप से किस रासायनिक पदार्थ से बनती है?
e: Gurde ki pathri (kidney stone) ki sabse aam sanrachna calcium oxalate (CaC2O4) ki hoti hai - ye calcium tatha oxalate (jaise palak, chukandar, chocolate mein) ke milne se banta hai aur gurde mein baith kar dard ka kaaran banta hai; kuchh pathriyan uric acid ya calcium phosphate ki bhi hoti hain. Isi karan jinke gurde mein pathri ki samasya ho, unhe paani adhik peene aur oxalate-wale bhojan kam karne ki salah di jaati hai. Iron, iodine ya zinc aisi pathri nahi banate - isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: gurde ki pathri ka mukhya roop calcium oxalate hi hota hai, jise calcium tatha oxalate milkar banate hain.

qe: Which mineral is essential for the formation of Hemoglobin?
qh: हीमोग्लोबिन के निर्माण के लिए कौन सा खनिज आवश्यक है?
e: Hemoglobin banane ke liye iron (loha) avashyak hai, kyunki uske 'heme' hisse ke kendra mein iron ion hota hai jo oxygen ke anuon ko bandhta hai aur unhe poore shareer mein le jaata hai. Iron na ho to heme band nahi paate, isliye hemoglobin kam banta hai aur anemia (khoon ki kami) ho jaati hai; isi liye iron ki goliyaan aur iron-yukt bhojan diye jaate hain. Calcium haddi ke liye aur iodine thyroid ke liye zaroori hai - wo hemoglobin ke dhanche ka hissa nahi hain. Exam point: hemoglobin ke nirman ke liye zaroori khaniz = iron (Fe), kyunki heme ke kendra mein iron oxygen bandhta hai.

qe: The deficiency of which mineral leads to Anemia?
qh: किस खनिज की कमी से एनीमिया (अरक्तता) होता है?
e: Anemia ka matlab khoon mein hemoglobin ki kami hai; hemoglobin ke heme hisse ka mukhya dhatu iron hota hai, isliye iron ki kami se hemoglobin banta nahi aur khoon kamzoor padta hai. Aise rogi ko thakaan, peela chehra aur saans phoolne ki samasya hoti hai - ilaaj iron-yukt bhojan (palak, gud, chana) aur iron supplement se hota hai. Calcium ya iodine ki kami se ye bimari nahi hoti (wo haddi tatha thyroid se jude hain), isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: anemia (khoon ki kami) iron ki kami se hota hai - kyunki iron ke bina hemoglobin ka nirman nahi hota.

qe: Which element/metal is essential for the conversion of Prothrombin to Thrombin?
qh: प्रोथ्रोम्बिन को थ्रोम्बिन में बदलने के लिए कौन सा तत्व/धातु आवश्यक है?
e: Rakt ke thakke (clot) banane ki prakriya mein prothrombin ko thrombin mein badalna padta hai, aur ye badlav calcium ion ki upasthiti mein hi hota hai; iske baad thrombin fibrin ko banata hai jo khaar ke roop mein khoon ko baandh deta hai. Isi karan calcium ki kami wale rog mein khoon jaldi nahi rukta aur chhoti chot se bhi adhik rakt-sraav hota hai. Iron hemoglobin ke liye zaroori hai, par is kriya (clotting) ke liye calcium hi mukhya hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: prothrombin ko thrombin mein badalne ke liye calcium (Ca) zaroori hai - isliye rakt ka thakka jamne (clotting) mein iski bhoomika hai.

qe: Which mineral's deficiency causes Anemia according to the context?
qh: संदर्भ के अनुसार किस खनिज की कमी से एनीमिया होता है?
e: Anemia (khoon mein hemoglobin ki kami) ka khaas kaaran khaniz ke roop mein iron ki kami hi hota hai; iron hemoglobin ke laal rang wale heme ka mukhya hissa hota hai isliye uski kami se hemoglobin ka nirman ruk jaata hai. Iske ilawa folic acid aur vitamin B12 ki kami se bhi alag prakar ka anemia (megaloblastic) hota hai, par khaniz mein iron hi sabse aam kaaran hai. Calcium, iodine aur zinc se ye bimari nahi hoti - ye haddi, thyroid tatha badh-vikas se jude hain. Exam point: anemia ka mukhya khaniz-janit kaaran iron ki kami hai; iski poori matara ke liye palak, gud aur kale chane upyogi hain.

qe: Which mineral is found in 'Hemoglobin' and its deficiency causes Anemia?
qh: 'हीमोग्लोबिन' में कौन सा खनिज पाया जाता है और इसकी कमी से एनीमिया होता है?
e: Panjabi-Hindi ke riwaz mein hemoglobin ko 'loha' hi kaha jaata hai - iska khaniz jod iron (Fe) hai, kyunki uske molecule mein iron ion oxygen ko bandhta hai aur ushe laal rang deta hai. Iski kami se hemoglobin ghat jaata hai aur anemia hone par thakaan, kamzori tatha chakkar aate hain; isi liye iron-yukt bhojan aur supplement istemal hote hain. Iodine thyroid ke liye aur calcium rakt-jamav (clotting) tatha haddi ke liye zaroori hai - wo hemoglobin ke mukhya dhatu nahi hain. Exam point: Hemoglobin (aur anemia) ka mukhya khaniz = iron (loha), jo oxygen ko vahan karta hai aur khoon ko laal rang deta hai.

qe: Which mineral is essential for the function of Hemoglobin?
qh: हीमोग्लोबिन के कार्य के लिए कौन सा खनिज आवश्यक है?
e: Rangheen hemoglobin sahi tarah kaam karne ke liye uske khand (heme) mein iron chaahiye - wahi iron oxygen ke anuon ko pakadta hai. Iske bina hemoglobin oxygen vahan nahi kar paata, isliye koshikaon ko urja kam milti hai aur vyakti ko thakaan tatha saans phoolne ki samasya hoti hai. Iron-yukt khaniz (Fe2+/Fe3+ ka santulan) isi liye haemoglobin ki kriya ke liye anivary hai. Calcium, sodium ya potassium seedha haemoglobin ke kaam ke liye zaroori nahi hain (wo anya kriyaon mein lagte hain). Exam point: hemoglobin ki kriya (oxygen vahan) ke liye iron khaniz zaroori hai - iske bina hemoglobin kaam nahi kar paata.

qe: Anemia is primarily caused by the deficiency of which mineral?
qh: एनीमिया मुख्य रूप से किस खनिज की कमी के कारण होता है?
e: Anemia ke mukhya khaniz-kaaran ke roop mein iron (loha) ko hi pehchana jaata hai, kyunki laal rakt-kan (RBC) ka laal rang wala hissa heme iron ke bina banta hi nahi. Khaniz ki kami se hone wale is rog mein pehle hemoglobin ki matara girti hai aur RBC chhote-pale (microcytic) ho jaate hain; isi karan blood test se ye bhi pata chalta hai ki kami iron ki hai. Vitamin B12 tatha folic acid ki kami se bhi anemia hota hai par wo khaniz ka vishay nahi hai, aur calcium ya zinc is bimari se seedhe jude nahi hote. Exam point: khaniz ki kami se hone wale anemia ka pramukh kaaran iron ki kami hi hai; isliye anemia mein iron-yukt aahar aur supplement diye jaate hain.

qe: Which symbol represents 'Mercury' used in a traditional BP machine?
qh: पारंपरिक बीपी मशीन में उपयोग किए जाने वाले 'पारे' (Mercury) का रासायनिक प्रतीक क्या है?
e: Purani BP machine (sphygmomanometer) mein para (mercury, Hg) bhara hota hai, isliye BP ko aaj bhi 'millimeter of Hg' (mmHg) mein likha jaata hai - ye dhaatu kamre ke taapman par drav rehti hai aur uski ghanatva adhik hone se patli nali mein matara ka maap saaf dikhta hai. Iska rasayanik symbol Hg hai (latin 'hydrargyrum' se aaya). Isi karan BP ke saath 'sona-para padaav' jaisi baatein bhi judti hain. Exam point: paramparik BP yantra mein istemal hone wali dhaatu para (mercury) ka symbol Hg hai; isliye BP ka matrak mmHg hota hai.

qe: Stones (Pathri) in the body are primarily made of which chemical compound?
qh: शरीर में पथरी मुख्य रूप से किस रासायनिक यौगिक से बनी होती है?
e: Is pathri ka mukhya ghatak calcium tatha oxalate ka jod (calcium oxalate) hota hai; gurde mein jab ye jama hone lagta hai to peshaab ke raste mein rukawat tatha tez dard hota hai. Iske ilawa kam matara mein uric acid tatha calcium phosphate wali pathriyan bhi ban sakti hain. Bachne ke liye paani adhik peena aur oxalate-wale padarth (palak, chukandar, chocolate) kam karna upyogi hota hai. Zinc, iron ya iodine aisi pathri ke mukhya ghatak nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: shareer mein pathri mukhya roop se calcium oxalate ki banti hai - calcium aur oxalate ke jama hone se.

qe: Which gas causes the maximum decay or damage to teeth?
qh: कौन सी गैस दांतों को सबसे अधिक नुकसान या क्षय पहुँचाती है?
e: Daanton ki bahari kathor parat 'enamel' fluroapatite jaisi khaniz se banti hai; jab paani mein fluorine ki matara bahut adhik ho jaati hai to daanton par 'dant-vaikriti' (dental fluorosis) hoti hai - daant par safed-pile dhabbe pad jaate hain, enamel kamzor ho jaati hai aur daant jaldi tootne lagte hain. Isi karan adhik fluoride wale kshetron mein daant kharab hone ki samasya dekhi jaati hai (kam matara to daant ke liye achhi hai, kyunki wo cavity rokta hai). Iron, calcium ya iodine ka daant par ye nuksan-karak asar nahi hota. Exam point: fluorine ki adhikta se daant kharab hote hain (dental fluorosis), isliye paani mein fluoride ki matara semblana zaroori hai.

qe: What is the main chemical component of teeth?
qh: दांतों का मुख्य रासायनिक घटक क्या है?
e: Daant ka sabse kathor hissa enamel calcium phosphate se banta hai (hydroxyapatite ke roop mein) - isi karan daant apne aap nahi ghulte aur kathor rehte hain. Isi baat ka ulta roop khaniz ke pighalne ki samasya hai: tez acid wale padarth (cold drinks) enamel ke calcium ko ghula dete hain, isliye daant kharab hote hain. Isliye daanton ke liye calcium tatha phosphorus wala aahar zaroori hota hai. Iron, iodine ya sodium daant ke dhanche ke mukhya hissa nahi hain. Exam point: daant ka mukhya rasayanik ghatak = calcium phosphate (hydroxyapatite), jo enamel ko kathorta deta hai.

qe: What is the chemical name of 'Bleaching Powder'?
qh: 'ब्लीचिंग पाउडर' का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Bleaching powder ka rasayanik naam calcium oxychloride hai (CaOCl2) - ye bujhe chune (Ca(OH)2) par chlorine gas ki kriya se banta hai aur isme calcium hypochlorite ka mishran hota hai. Paani mein ghulne par ye chlorine chhodta hai, isliye ise paani ki safai (disinfection), farash tatha safai-gharon ki safai aur kapdon ki bleaching ke liye istemal karte hain. Calcium carbonate chuna-patthar hai, calcium sulfate jipsum aur calcium oxide safed chuna - ye teeno bleaching powder ke sahi naam nahi hain. Exam point: bleaching powder ka rasayanik naam calcium oxychloride (CaOCl2) hai; ye chlorine ke karan khoonkhar (disinfectant) aur bleaching ka kaam karta hai.

qe: Which process involves the accumulation of molecular species at the surface rather than in the bulk?
qh: किस प्रक्रिया में आणविक प्रजातियों का संचय थोक के बजाय सतह पर होता है?
e: Adsorption (adhishoshan) wo kriya hai jismein kisi padarth ke anu (molecules) apni poore aayatan mein phailne ke bajaye sirf satah (surface) par jama ho jaate hain - jaise charcoal par gas, ya paani ki satah par tel ki patli parat. Isme padarth satah par chipak jaata hai aur andar nahi ghusta, isliye satah ka kshetrafal (surface area) jitna bada ho, adsorption utna hi adhik hota hai (isliye charcoal ko activated kiya jaata hai). Absorption mein padarth poore aayatan mein ghusta hai (jaise paani sukhi mitti mein). Exam point: satah par anuon ka jama hona = adsorption (surface phenomenon), jo absorption se alag hai (usme padarth andar tak jaata hai).

qe: Which of the following is an example of 'Physical Adsorption' (Physisorption)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'भौतिक अधिशोषण' का उदाहरण है?
o: Adsorption of gases on charcoal | चारकोल पर गैसों का अधिशोषण
e: Physical adsorption (physisorption) mein gas ke anu charcoal ki satah par keval durbal van der Waals bal se chipak jaate hain - ismein koi rasayanik bandhan nahi banta, isliye ye uttarkarmi (reversible) hota hai aur taap badhane par gam (desorption) ho jaata hai. Charcoal par gas ka jama hona iska sabse aam udaharan hai (isliye gas mask mein charcoal bhara jaata hai). Chemisorption mein prabal rasayanik bal bante hain aur ye anutkarmi hota hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi. Exam point: charcoal par gas ka jama (physisorption) physical adsorption ka udaharan hai - ye durbal van der Waals bal se hota hai, isliye reversible hota hai.

qe: What is 'Tyndall Effect'?
qh: 'टिंडल प्रभाव' क्या है?
o: Scattering of light by colloidal particles | कोलाइडल कणों द्वारा प्रकाश का प्रकीर्णन
e: Tyndall effect ka matlab hai ki colloid ke chhote kanon se roshni ka bikharav (scattering) hona, jisse light ki seedhi rekha (path) saaf dikhaai deti hai - jaise dhoop mein dhool bhare kamre ya ped se aate hue roshni ki kiranon mein, ya doodh mein torch ki roshni. Ye effect tab hota hai jab kan ka aakaar light ki tarangdairdhya ke lagbhag ho (colloid ke kan 1-1000 nm hote hain). Sachcha ghulaimaan mein kan bahut chhote hone se ye effect nahi hota, isliye ye colloid aur solution mein antar batane ka tarika hai. Exam point: colloidal kanon dwara roshni ka bikharav = Tyndall effect (light ka path dikhna), jo solution mein nahi dikhta.

qe: What is 'Brownian Movement' in colloids?
qh: कोलाइड्स में 'ब्राउनियन गति' क्या है?
o: Zig-zag motion of particles | कणों की टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी गति
e: Brownian movement colloid ke kanon ki behad tez, seedhi (random) tedhi-medhi gati hai - ye gati kanon par drav ke anuon ki asaman takkar ke karan hoti hai, isliye har kan har pal disha badalta rehta hai. Isi gati ke karan colloid ke kan neeche baith nahi paate aur colloid sthir rehta hai; isse yahi sabit hota hai ki colloid ke kan bahut chhote hain par unka aakaar sachche ghulaimaan se bada hota hai. Iska naam vaigyanik Robert Brown ke naam par pada hai. Exam point: colloid ke kanon ki tedhi-medhi (zig-zag) gati = Brownian movement, jo drav ke anuon ki takkar se hoti hai aur colloid ko sthir rakhti hai.

qe: Which type of 'Colloid' is 'Milk'?
qh: 'दूध' किस प्रकार का 'कोलाइड' है?
e: Doodh ek 'emulsion' (paayas) hai - ismein drav vasa (tel jaisa) ki chhoti boondein doosre drav (paani wale hisse) mein phaili rehti hain aur unhe protein (casein) ki parat sthir rakhti hai. Yahi karan hai ki doodh ko kuchh samay chhod dene par bhi tel ki parat upar nahi aati aur usmein light ka bikharav (Tyndall effect) dikhta hai. Foam, aerosol aur gel alag prakar ke colloid hain - isliye wo vikalp doodh ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: doodh ek emulsion hai - ismein drav vasa ki boondein doosre drav mein phaili hoti hain, jise protein ne sthir kiya hota hai.

qe: Which substance is used as a 'Catalyst' in the manufacture of $NH_3$ by Haber's Process?
qh: हैबर प्रक्रम द्वारा $NH_3$ के निर्माण में 'उत्प्रेरक' के रूप में किस पदार्थ का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Haber process mein nitrogen aur hydrogen ko milakar ammonia banaya jaata hai (N2 + 3H2 -> 2NH3), aur is kriya ki gati badhane ke liye utprerak (catalyst) ke roop mein shudh loha (iron) istemal hota hai, jiske saath molybdenum thoda promoter ka kaam karta hai. Isi karan ye kriya 400-500 degree C aur 150-200 atmosphere dabav par ki jaati hai, taaki ammonia ka yield achha mile. Nickel, platinum ya vanadium oxide anya kriyaon ke utprerak hain, isliye wo yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: Haber process mein NH3 banane ka catalyst = iron (loha), jiske saath molybdenum promoter ka kaam karta hai.

qe: What is 'Peptization'?
qh: 'पेप्टीकरण' क्या है?
o: Breaking a precipitate into colloidal sol | अवक्षेप को कोलाइडल सोल में तोड़ना
e: Peptization wo kriya hai jismein ek naya bana avakshep (precipitate) ko dhone (washing) ke baad kisi vidyutapghatak (electrolyte) ki thodi matara daalkar colloid sol mein badal diya jaata hai - aise padarth ko peptizing agent kehte hain. Yahi kriya fresh precipitate ko colloid ke roop mein sthir rakhti hai, jaise ferric hydroxide ka precipitate FeCl3 se ghul kar colloid sol bana deta hai. Coagulation iska ulta hai (kanon ka jama hona), aur dialysis shuddhikaran hai - isliye wo vikalp peptization ke sahi nahi. Exam point: precipitate ko colloid sol mein badalne ki kriya = peptization; ismein thoda electrolyte (peptizing agent) daala jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Dialysis' used for in chemistry?
qh: रसायन विज्ञान में 'डायलिसिस' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Purification of colloids | कोलाइड्स का शुद्धिकरण
e: Dialysis ek shuddhikaran vidhi hai jismein colloid ke ghulaimaan ko ek ardha-paariparshvik (semipermeable) jhili wale thaili mein rakha jaata hai - chhote anu tatha ion (jaise namak, glucose) jhili se bahar nikal jaate hain, par bade colloid kan andar hi reh jaate hain; is tarah colloid se unki ashuddhiyaan hat jaati hain. Isi tarah gurde (kidney) bhi khoon se chhoti ashuddhiyaan chhaan kar hataate hain, isliye dialysis ka istemal gurde ke rogiyon mein bhi hota hai. Filtration, distillation ya sublimation is kriya ke roop nahi hain. Exam point: dialysis = colloid ka shuddhikaran; semipermeable jhili se chhote ion-ashuddhi bahar nikal jaati hain aur colloid kan andar reh jaate hain.

qe: What is the charge on 'Gold Sol' particles?
qh: 'गोल्ड सोल' कणों पर कौन सा आवेश होता है?
e: Gold sol (Au colloid) ke kanon par rin (negative) aavesh hota hai - ye aavesh kanon ki satah par ionon ke fasne (adsorption) se paida hota hai; isi samaan aavesh ke karan kan ek doosre se vikarshit hokar door rehte hain aur sol sthir bana rehta hai. Iske ulat jab hum vidyutapghatak daalte hain to ye aavesh hatt jaata hai aur gold ke kanon ka jamav (coagulation) ho jaata hai. Isi karan sadharan sol mein safed rang hi dikhta hai par kan ke aakaar badalne par rang (laal/neela) badal jaata hai. Exam point: gold sol ke kanon par rin (negative) aavesh hota hai; samaan aavesh ke karan kan door rehte hain aur sol sthir rehta hai.

qe: Which rule explains the 'Coagulating Power' of an ion?
qh: कौन सा नियम किसी आयन की 'स्कंदन शक्ति' (Coagulating Power) की व्याख्या करता है?
e: Hardy-Schulze rule kehta hai ki kisi colloid ke kanon ko bandhne (coagulate) karne ki kshamta vidyutapghatak (electrolyte) ke aavesh aur uski sankhya par nirbhar karti hai - jitna adhik aavesh (charge) wala ayank ho, utni hi kam matara mein wo coagulate karta hai. Aise multivalent ayank (jaise +3 wala Al3+) ki coagulating power sabse adhik hoti hai, kyunki wo kanon ka aavesh bina kisi gaman ke udasin kar deta hai. Isi karan namak daalne par doodh ya rubber ka latex phat (coagulate) jaata hai. Exam point: ayank ki coagulating power samjhane wala niyam = Hardy-Schulze rule; jitna adhik aavesh (charge), utni adhik coagulation kshamta.

qe: What is 'Cheese' an example of?
qh: 'पनीर' किसका उदाहरण है?
e: Cheese ek 'gel' hai - ismein drav (paani wala hissa) ek thos jaal (network) ke andar bhara rehta hai; cheese banane ke liye doodh mein rennet enzyme ya acid daala jaata hai jisse casein protein ka jaal banta hai aur paani usmein fas jaata hai. Isi karan cheese ko kata ja sakta hai par ismein se paani rista nahi. Emulsion (jaise doodh), aerosol (jaise dhuaan) aur foam alag prakar ke colloid hain - isliye wo cheese ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: cheese ek gel hai - ismein drav (paani) thos jaal (casein protein) ke andar bhara rehta hai; isliye ye kata jaata hai par rista nahi.

qe: What is an 'Emulsifier'?
qh: 'पायसीकारी' (Emulsifier) क्या है?
o: A substance that stabilizes an emulsion | एक पदार्थ जो इमल्शन को स्थिर करता है
e: Emulsifier wo padarth hota hai jo drav-drav wale colloid (emulsion) ke chhote kanon ko ek doosre se milne se rokta hai aur unhe lambe samay tak sthir rakhta hai - jaise doodh mein casein protein, mayonnaise mein ande ka yolk tatha saabun ka molecule. Aise padarth ka ek sira paani mein ghulta hai aur doosra tel mein, isliye wo kanon ke around parat banakar unhe bandh hone se bachaata hai. Daane (precipitate) bahar nikalne ya coagulation karne wale padarth emulsifier nahi hote. Exam point: emulsifier = wo padarth jo emulsion ko sthir rakhta hai (jaise doodh mein protein, mayo mein yolk); ye tel-paani ke kanon ke beech parat banata hai.

qe: What is 'Shape-selective' catalysis?
qh: 'आकृति-चयनात्मक' उत्प्रेरण क्या है?
o: Catalysis by Zeolites | जिओलाइट्स द्वारा उत्प्रेरण
e: Zeolites (jaise ZSM-5) ki sanrachna mein ek nishchit aakaar ke chhed (pores) tatha gahvar (cavities) hote hain; unke andar sirf utne hi aakaar ke anu ghusta hai aur wahi kriya kar sakte hain - isi karan zeolite dwara ki jaane wali utpreran (catalysis) ko 'shape-selective' (aakaar-chayanak) kehte hain. Iska sabse mashhoor udaharan petroleum ke hidrokarbon ka aisa parivartan hai jisme sirf khaas aakaar ke anu bante hain (gasoline ka octane number badhane ke liye). Platina, nickel jaise saadharan catalyst par aisa aakaar ka niyam nahi hota. Exam point: zeolites dwara hone wali catalysis shape-selective kehlati hai - kyunki chhed ka aakaar hi tay karta hai ki kaun sa anu andar jaayega.

qe: What is the size range of 'Colloidal' particles?
qh: 'कोलाइडल' कणों का आकार क्या होता है?
o: 1 nm to 1000 nm | 1 nm से 1000 nm
e: Colloidal kanon ka aakaar 1 nanometre se 1000 nanometre (1 nm se 1000 nm) ke beech hota hai - yani sachche ghulaimaan (solution) ke kanon (1 nm se kam) se bada tatha suspension ke kanon (1000 nm se adhik) se chhota. Yahi aakaar unhe dono ke beech ki khaas property deta hai: ye neeche nahi baithte (Brownian gati ke karan) par filter paper se nahi guzarte, aur light ka bikharav (Tyndall effect) dikhate hain. Solution aur suspension ke aakaar is range se bahar hote hain, isliye wo vikalp colloidal size ka sahi jod nahi. Exam point: colloidal kan 1 nm se 1000 nm tak hote hain - isi madhyam aakaar se unki khaas pehchaan (Tyndall effect, sthirta) banti hai.

qe: Which gas is adsorbed most easily on activated charcoal?
qh: सक्रिय चारकोल पर कौन सी गैस सबसे आसानी से अधिशोषित होती है?
e: Activated charcoal par CO2 gas sabse aasaani se jam jaati (adsorb) hai - kyunki CO2 ka kvathank tatha kritic tapman adhik hota hai, isliye uske anu charcoal ki satah par prabal aakarshan se bandh jaate hain; gas ka adsorption utna hi adhik hota hai jitna dusra uske dravibhavan (liquefaction) ka jhukaav zyada ho. Isi karan gases ko alag karne tatha gas mask mein (zeherili gas rokne ke liye) charcoal istemal hota hai. Hydrogen jaise kam kvathank wale gases kam adsorb hote hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: activated charcoal par CO2 sabse aasaani se adsorb hoti hai, kyunki adhik kvathank wali gas ka adsorption zyada hota hai.

qe: What is 'Electrophoresis' used to determine?
qh: 'इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस' का उपयोग क्या निर्धारित करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Charge on colloidal particles | कोलाइडल कणों पर आवेश
e: Electrophoresis ek vidhi hai jismein colloid ke ghulaimaan par vidyut kshetra lagaya jaata hai; kanon par aavesh hone ke karan dhanaveshi kan rin dhrub ki or tatha rinaveshi kan dhan dhrub ki or sarak jaate hain, isliye is kriya se ye pata chalta hai ki colloid ke kanon par kaunsa aavesh (dhan ya rin) hai. Isi karan aavesh ke anusaar kanon ki gati alag hoti hai aur unhe alag-alag kar sakte hain (protein aur DNA alag karne mein yahi vidhi kaam aati hai). Kanon ka aakaar ya ghulaimaan ka rang is kriya se seedha tay nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: electrophoresis se colloid kanon par aavesh (charge) ka pata chalata hai - kan vidyut kshetra mein ulta dhrub pakadte hain.

qe: Which substance acts as a 'Poison' for the catalyst in Haber's Process?
qh: हैबर प्रक्रम में उत्प्रेरक के लिए 'विष' (Poison) के रूप में कौन सा पदार्थ कार्य करता है?
e: Haber process mein loha (iron) utprerak ka kaam karta hai; agar reactor mein carbon monoxide (CO) aa jaaye to wo loha ki satah par mazbuti se chipak (chemisorb) jaata hai aur catalyst ki karyashil satah (active surface) ko dhak leta hai - isse utprerak ka asar khatm ho jaata hai, isliye CO ko 'catalyst poison' kehte hain. Isi wajah se synthesis gas (N2 + H2) se CO ko pehle hi saaf kar liya jaata hai. Nitrogen ya hydrogen poison nahi hain (wo kriya-karak hain), aur iron khud utprerak hai. Exam point: Haber process mein catalyst ka zeher (poison) = CO (carbon monoxide), jo loha ki satah par chipak kar utprerak ko nishkriya kar deta hai.

qe: What is 'Fog' an example of?
qh: 'कोहरा' किसका उदाहरण है?
o: Liquid dispersed in gas (Aerosol) | गैस में परिक्षिप्त तरल
e: Dhund (fog) mein chhoti drav boondein hawa (gas) mein phaili rehti hain, isliye ise 'liquid dispersed in gas' wala aerosol kehte hain - kyunki ismein parikshipat padarth (dispersed phase) drav aur parikshipat madhyam (dispersion medium) gas hota hai. Iske ulat dhuaan mein thos kan gas mein hote hain (solid aerosol). Isi karan dhund mein roshni ka bikharav (Tyndall effect) dikhta hai aur gadi ki headlight ki kiran aise dikhti hai. Isi karan dhund ko dhuaan, geera (gel) ya jhaag (foam) ke saath na milayein - wo sab alag prakar ke colloid hain. Exam point: dhund (fog) ek aerosol hai jismein drav (boondein) gas mein parikshipat hoti hai; dhuaan mein thos kan gas mein hote hain.

qe: What is 'Lyophilic' sol?
qh: 'द्रवरागी' (Lyophilic) सोल क्या है?
e: Lyophilic sol wo colloid hota hai jismein parikshipat padarth (dispersed phase) drav (medium) se 'prem' (affinity) rakhta hai - yani usme ghulna-khulna pasand karta hai; starch, gum, gelatin aur protein jaise padarthon se bane sol aise hote hain. Isi liye ye sol aasaani se ban jaate hain, unmein kanon par aavesh ke saath-saath solvent ki parat bhi hoti hai aur bhaap-banakar (vapour) punah sol mein badle ja sakte hain. Lyophobic sol (jaise gold sol) mein aisa affinity nahi hota. Exam point: lyophilic sol = drav-snehi colloid, jismein padarth drav se judta (affinity) hai - jaise starch, gum aur gelatin ke sol.

qe: What is 'Auto-catalysis'?
qh: 'स्व-उत्प्रेरण' क्या है?
o: One of the products acts as a catalyst | उत्पादों में से एक उत्प्रेरक के रूप में कार्य करता है
e: Auto-catalysis wo kriya hai jismein kisi abhikarmak ka nirmit (formed) utpad hi utprerak ka kaam karne lagta hai - isliye kriya shuru mein dheemi hoti hai aur jaise-jaise utpad banta hai, gati badhti jaati hai. Aise utprerak ko self-catalyst kehte hain; udaharan: KMnO4 dwara oxalic acid ka oxidation, jismein bane Mn2+ ion kriya ko tez karte hain. Iske ulat, negative catalyst kriya ko dheema karta hai aur heterogeneous catalysis mein utprerak alag avastha mein hota hai. Exam point: auto-catalysis mein utpad khud utprerak ban jaata hai (swayan-utpreran); isliye gati shuru mein kam aur baad mein adhik hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Dispersion Phase' in Smoke?
qh: धुएं में 'परिक्षेपण प्रावस्था' (Dispersion Phase) क्या है?
e: Dhuaan (smoke) mein thos ke chhote kan hawa (gas) mein phaile rehte hain, isliye iska parikshipat padarth (dispersion phase) thos hota hai - yani solid aerosol hai. Iske ulat dhund (fog) mein boondein (drav) aur hawa (gas) hota hai; isliye 'parikshipat padarth' batane wale prashn mein smoke ke liye solid hi sahi jod hai. Isi karan dhuaan ka rang thos kanon par nirbhar karta hai (kala, safed ya bhoora) aur wo long time tak hawa mein tairta reh sakta hai. Gas ya drav parikshipat padarth smoke ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: dhuaan (smoke) mein parikshipat padarth = thos (solid), kyunki ye thos kan gas mein failne se banta hai (solid aerosol).

qe: Which adsorption is 'Irreversible' in nature?
qh: कौन सा अधिशोषण प्रकृति में 'अनुत्क्रमणीय' (Irreversible) है?
e: Chemisorption (rasayanik adhishoshan) mein gas ke anu tatha satah ke beech rasayanik bandhan (lagbhag covalent) ban jaate hain, isliye ye prabal aur sthir hota hai - ek baar padarth chipak jaaye to halki garam karne par nahi hatta, isliye ise anutkarmi (irreversible) kehte hain. Physical adsorption (physisorption) mein durbal van der Waals bal hote hain, isliye wo utkarmi hota hai (garam karne par gas nikal jaati hai). Isi karan catalyst ki satah par gas ke rasayanik adhishoshan se hi kriya hoti hai. Exam point: anutkarmi (irreversible) adhishoshan = chemisorption, kyunki ismein satah par rasayanik bandhan banta hai (physisorption utkarmi hota hai).

qe: What is the 'Gold Number' a measure of?
qh: 'गोल्ड नंबर' किसका माप है?
o: Protective power of lyophilic colloids | द्रवरागी कोलाइड्स की सुरक्षात्मक शक्ति
e: Gold number ek maap hai jo batata hai ki lyophilic colloid (jaise gelatin, starch) kisi lyophobic colloid (jaise gold sol) ko bandhne (coagulate) hone se kitna bachaata hai - yani uski surakshatmak shakti (protective power) kitni hai. Jitna kam gold number, utni adhik surakshatmak shakti (kyunki thodi matara mein hi sol ko bachaa deta hai); ise 10 mL gold sol mein milane wale lyophilic colloid ke miligram mein maapa jaata hai. Kanon ka aakaar ya ghulaimaan ka pH isse tay nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: gold number lyophilic colloid ki surakshatmak shakti (protective power) ka maap hai; kam gold number ka matlab adhik suraksha.

qe: What is 'Micelle' formation temperature called?
qh: 'मिसेल' निर्माण तापमान को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Surfactant (jaise saabun) ke anu paani mein ek nishchit tapman se upar mil kar guchchhe (micelle) banana shuru karte hain, jismein unke tel-pasand sira andar aur paani-pasand sira bahar rehta hai; jis tapman ke upar ye micelle banne lagte hain use Kraft temperature kehte hain. Isi tarah ek nishchit sandrata se adhik matara par micelle bante hain, jise CMC (critical micelle concentration) kehte hain. Iske ulat, tapman ya sandrata kam hone par micelle nahi bante aur safai ka asar kam ho jaata hai. Exam point: micelle banne ka nishchit tapman = Kraft temperature; isse neeche surfactant micelle nahi banata.

qe: Which 'Catalyst' is used in the hydrogenation of vegetable oils?
qh: वनस्पति तेलों के हाइड्रोजनीकरण में किस 'उत्प्रेरक' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Vanaspati ghee aur anya khane wale tel (unsaturated) ko hydrogen se bharkar thos (hydrogenated) banane ke liye utprerak ke roop mein nickel (Ni) ka istemal hota hai - is kriya mein tel ke double bandhan toot kar hydrogen jud jaate hain (isliye tel ka melting point badh jaata hai aur wo vanaspati ban jaata hai). Isi karan vanaspati banane ko 'hydrogenation' kehte hain aur nikal (Ni) 'catalyst' hota hai. Platinum ya palladium mehnge hote hain, aur vanadium pentoxide H2SO4 banane ke liye hota hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi. Exam point: vanaspati tel ke hydrogenation mein catalyst = nickel (Ni), jo double bandhan todkar tel ko thos ghee mein badal deta hai.

qe: What is 'Enzyme' catalysis also known as?
qh: 'एंजाइम' उत्प्रेरण को और किस रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Jab utprerak (catalyst) khud jeevit padarth (enzyme/protein) ho, to aisi utpreran ko enzyme-utpreran ya jeev-rasayanik utpreran (biochemical catalysis) kehte hain - jaise amilase, pepsin, trypsin khaane ko pachaate hain. Enzymes bahut nirdisht (specific) hote hain (ek enzyme ek hi abhikarmak par kaam karta hai) aur saririk tapman (37 degree C) par hi best kaam karte hain. Homogeneous ya heterogeneous catalysis alag aadhaar par banti hai (avashtha ke aadhaar par), isliye wo is khaas naam ki jagah nahi hain. Exam point: enzyme catalysis ko biochemical catalysis kehte hain - ye utpreran jeev-koshikaon ke andar nirdisht (specific) enzymes se hoti hai.

qe: Which process is used to remove 'Arsenic' impurities from water using colloids?
qh: कोलाइड्स का उपयोग करके पानी से 'आर्सेनिक' अशुद्धियों को दूर करने के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Paani mein ghule arsenic jaise zeherile ion ko hatane ke liye usme thoda vidyutapghatak daalkar colloid kanon ka jamav (coagulation) kiya jaata hai - isse zeherile ion colloid ke saath jam jaate hain aur talab (settling) tatha chhanan (filtration) se alag ho jaate hain. Yahi kriya jal-shodhan (water treatment) mein peene ke paani se ashuddhi hataane ke liye istemal hoti hai (aaj-kal alum jaisa coagulant daala jaata hai). Dialysis ya electrophoresis shodhan ke anya tarike hain, par zeher hataane ka saadharan tarika coagulation hi maana jaata hai. Exam point: colloid ki madad se paani se arsenic jaisi ashuddhi hataane ke liye coagulation kriya ka istemal hota hai (kan jam jaate hain aur alag kiye jaate hain).

qe: What is 'Lyophobic' sol?
qh: 'द्रवविरागी' (Lyophobic) सोल क्या है?
e: Lyophobic sol wo colloid hai jismein parikshipat padarth drav se koi 'prem' (attraction) nahi rakhta - yani usme ghulna ushe pasand nahi hota; jaise gold, silver, sulfur aur ferric hydroxide ke sol. Isliye ye sol aasaani se nahi bante, inmein kanon par keval aavesh hone se sthirta aati hai, isliye thoda vidyutapghatak daalte hi ye jam (coagulate) jaate hain. Lyophilic (drav-snehi) sol mein ye affinity hoti hai, isliye wo zyada sthir hote hain. Exam point: lyophobic sol = drav-virodhi colloid, jismein padarth drav se nahi judta (jaise gold sol); ye vidyutapghatak daalte hi jam jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Dispersing Medium' in Cloud?
qh: बादल में 'परिक्षेपण माध्यम' (Dispersing Medium) क्या है?
e: Baadal (cloud) mein chhoti paani ki boondein hawa (gas) mein phaile rehti hain - isliye iska parikshipat madhyam (dispersion medium) gas (hawa) hota hai aur parikshipat padarth (phase) drav. Isi karan baadal bhi ek aerosol hai, jaise dhund; dhuaan mein padarth thos hota hai. Isi baat ka farq samajhna zaroori hai: medium gas hai to aerosol, medium drav hai to emulsion, aur medium thos hai to gel/foam. Exam point: baadal (cloud) mein parikshipat madhyam = gas (hawa); isiliye ye drav-in-gas wala aerosol hota hai.

qe: What is 'Adsorbate'?
qh: 'अधिशोष्य' (Adsorbate) क्या है?
o: Substance that gets adsorbed | वह पदार्थ जो अधिशोषित होता है
e: Adsorbate wo padarth hota hai jo satah (surface) par jam (adsorbed) hota hai - jaise charcoal ki satah par chipki gas, ya paani ke upar faili tel ki patli parat; iske ulat adsorbent wo satah/ thos padarth hai jispar jama hota hai (jaise charcoal). Isi jode se samjhein: jamne wala padarth adsorbate hota hai aur jispar jamta hai wo adsorbent. 'Padarth jismein jam hota hai' ya 'jo utprerak ka kaam karta hai' wale kathan adsorbate ki paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: adsorbate = wo padarth jo kisi satah par jam (adsorb) hota hai; jis satah par jam hota hai use adsorbent kehte hain.

qe: Which type of 'Adsorption' increases with an increase in temperature?
qh: किस प्रकार का 'अधिशोषण' तापमान में वृद्धि के साथ बढ़ता है?
e: Chemisorption (rasayanik adhishoshan) mein gas tatha satah ke beech rasayanik bandhan banta hai, jo urja lene wala (endothermic) jaise dikhta hai; kyunki ye ek aktiva-urja wali kriya hai, isliye tapman badhane par pehle iska adhishoshan badh jaata hai (zyda anu ko aktiva-urja milne lagti hai) - yani ye tapman ke saath badhta hai. Physisorption mein ulata hoye hota hai (tapman badhne par adhishoshan ghat jaata hai kyunki van der Waals bal kamzor pad jaate hain). Isi karan ye prashn chemisorption ke uttar deta hai. Exam point: tapman badhne par badhne wala adhishoshan = chemisorption (rasayanik); physisorption tapman badhne par ghat jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Homogeneous' catalysis?
qh: 'समांगी' (Homogeneous) उत्प्रेरण क्या है?
o: Catalyst and reactants are in same phase | उत्प्रेरक और अभिकारक एक ही प्रावस्था में हैं
e: Homogeneous catalysis mein utprerak (catalyst) aur kriya-karak (reactants) ek hi avastha (phase) mein hote hain - jaise paani mein ghule acid ki utpreran se ester banana, ya gas avastha mein chlorine dwara ozon ka tootna. Aise utpreran mein utprerak poore mishran mein saman roop se phaila hota hai aur kriya ke baad wahi roop mein wapas milta hai. Heterogeneous catalysis mein utprerak alag avastha ka hota hai (jaise thos loha gas-kriya mein), isliye wo is paribhasha ke nahi. Exam point: homogeneous catalysis mein utprerak aur abhikarak ek hi avastha (phase) mein hote hain - jaise paani mein ghula acid esterification ko tez karta hai.

qe: Which 'Catalyst' is used in the manufacture of $H_2SO_4$ by Contact Process?
qh: संपर्क प्रक्रम द्वारा $H_2SO_4$ के निर्माण में किस 'उत्प्रेरक' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Contact process dwara sulfuric acid (H2SO4) banane mein mukhya pad mein sulfur dioxide ko sulfur trioxide mein badalna hota hai (2SO2 + O2 -> 2SO3), aur iske liye utprerak ke roop mein vanadium pentoxide (V2O5) - ya purane tarike mein platinum - istemal hota hai. Isi karan ise 'contact process' kehte hain, kyunki gasen thos utprerak ki satah se sampark karti hain. Nickel hydrogenation ke liye aur loha ammonia ke liye utprerak hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: contact process mein H2SO4 banane ka catalyst = vanadium pentoxide (V2O5), jo SO2 ko SO3 mein badalta hai.

qe: What is 'CMC' (Critical Micelle Concentration)?
qh: 'CMC' (क्रांतिक मिसेल सांद्रता) क्या है?
o: Concentration above which micelles form | सांद्रता जिसके ऊपर मिसेल बनते हैं
e: Surfactant ke anu paani mein pehle alag-alag (monomer ke roop mein) ghulte hain; jab unki sandrata ek nishchit seema (CMC) se upar ho jaati hai to wo aapas mein mil kar micelle (guchchhe) banane lagte hain, jinmein tel-pasand hissa andar aur paani-pasand hissa bahar rehta hai. Isi karan CMC se upar surface tension sthir ho jaata hai aur safai/prakshalan ka asar bahut badh jaata hai. Isliye CMC colloid vigyaan tatha saabun-drav vigyaan ka mukhya aankda hai. Temperature ya aavesh iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: CMC (critical micelle concentration) = wo sandrata jiske upar surfactant micelle banane lagta hai; isse kam sandrata par safai ka asar kam hota hai.

qe: Which gas is primarily responsible for the 'Greenhouse Effect'?
qh: 'ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव' के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी गैस जिम्मेदार है?
e: Greenhouse effect ke liye CO2 mukhya gas hai kyunki wo infraraid (garmi) kirnon ko paas hone nahi deta aur wapas zameen ki or bhej deta hai, jisse vaayumandal ka tapman badhta hai; jalne se nikalne wali CO2 (koyla, tel, gas) iska sabse bada kaaran hai. Methane aur nitrous oxide bhi greenhouse gases hain par unki matara CO2 se kam hoti hai; oxygen aur nitrogen is effect mein koi bhumika nahi rakhte. Isi liye greenhouse gas ki ginti ka aadhaar uske 'global warming potential' par hota hai. Exam point: greenhouse effect ke liye mukhya roop se uttaradayi gas = carbon dioxide (CO2), jo infraraid kirnon ko rok kar vaayumandal ko garam karti hai.

qe: What is 'Eutrophication' of water bodies caused by?
qh: जलाशयों में 'सुपोषण' (Eutrophication) किसके कारण होता है?
o: Excessive nutrients like Nitrates and Phosphates
e: Jab jheel-talab ke paani mein khad (nitrate aur phosphate) ki matara bahut badh jaati hai to algae (shaiwal) jaldi badh jaate hain aur unke marne par paani mein oxygen kam pad jaati hai - isi kriya ko eutrophication kehte hain, jisse paani ke jeev mar jaate hain aur paani ganda-ho jaata hai. Ye samasya talaab mein khad ke bahav (runoff) se hoti hai; isi liye 'nutrient pollution' iska doosra naam hai. Sadharan namak tatha bhari dhatuein iska mukhya kaaran nahi (unse alag prakar ki samasya hoti hai). Exam point: eutrophication paani mein nitrate-phosphat jaisi adhik paudh-poshak matara aane se hoti hai - algae badhne aur oxygen ghatne ke karan.

qe: Which class of chemicals is responsible for 'Ozone Layer Depletion'?
qh: 'ओजोन परत के क्षरण' के लिए रसायनों का कौन सा वर्ग जिम्मेदार है?
e: Ozone layer ka patla hona mukhya roop se chlorofluorocarbon (CFC) aur halo-carbon gases se hota hai; ye gases upar jaakar ultraviolet kirnon se toot te hain aur chlorine/bromine ke mukta mul-kanaon (free radicals) chhodte hain, jo ozone ke ek-ek anu ko baaram-baaram todte rehte hain. Isi liye Montreal protocol ke tahat CFC ka istemal ban kiya gaya. CO2 ya SO2 ozone ko seedha nahi todte (wo greenhouse/green alag samasyayein dete hain), isliye 'both B and C' wala jod yahi sahi hai. Exam point: ozone layer depletion ke liye mukhya roop se CFC aur halo carbons (aur thoda nitrogen oxide bhi) uttaradayi hote hain - isliye Montreal protocol hua.

qe: What is 'Biochemical Oxygen Demand' (BOD) a measure of?
qh: 'बायोकेमिकल ऑक्सीजन डिमांड' (BOD) किसका माप है?
e: BOD (biochemical oxygen demand) batata hai ki paani mein maujood jaivik (organic) padarth ko sukshm-jeevon (bacteria) dwara todne mein kitni oxygen lagti hai - ye O2 ki matara milligram per litre mein maape jaate hain. Jitna adhik BOD, utna hi zyada organic pradushan (gandagi) hota hai, isliye BOD saaf-saphal paani ka pradushan-maap hai (talaab ka saaf paani BOD kam dikhata hai, ganda paani adhik). Isi tarah water quality report karte hain. Pani ka pH ya tagata (hardness) BOD ka vishay nahi hain. Exam point: BOD paani mein organic pradushan ka maap hai - adhik BOD ka matlab zyada gandagi aur kam oxygen (safe maan 5 ppm se kam).

qe: What is 'PAN' (Peroxyacetyl Nitrate) in environmental chemistry?
qh: पर्यावरण रसायन विज्ञान में 'PAN' (पेरोक्सीएसिटाइल नाइट्रेट) क्या है?
o: A secondary pollutant in photochemical smog
e: PAN (peroxyacetyl nitrate) ek drvitiy (secondary) pradushak hai jo photochemical smog mein banta hai - jab NOx tatha VOC par surya ki tirchi kirnein (UV) padti hain to ozone ke saath-saath PAN bhi paida hota hai. Ye aam taur par aankh mein jalan, saans lene mein taklif tatha paudhon ke liye hanikarak hota hai. NOx ya SO2 drvitiy pradushak nahi (primary hote hain, jo seedha chhajje se nikalte hain), isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: PAN (peroxyacetyl nitrate) photochemical smog mein banta wala drvitiy pradushak hai, jo UV roshni tatha NOx-VOC ki kriya se paida hota hai.

qe: Which metal is responsible for 'Minamata Disease' caused by industrial waste in water?
qh: जल में औद्योगिक कचरे के कारण होने वाली 'मिनीमाता बीमारी' के लिए कौन सी धातु जिम्मेदार है?
e: Minamata rog ka kaaran para (mercury) hai - factory ke kachre se methylmercury paani mein jaata hai, machhliyon mein chadhta hai tatha unhe khaane wale logon ke shareer mein pahunch kar dimaag aur nas (nerves) ko nashtar karta hai (Japan ke Minamata shehar mein yahi hua tha). Isi karan aise paari pradushan ko rokne ke liye aaj kadi niyam bane hain. Sisa (lead) se anya samasya (anemia, damag), cadmium se 'itai-itai' rog aur arsenic se twacha-tantrika (skin lesions) hoti hain - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Minamata rog ka liye uttaradayi dhatu = para (mercury), jo methylmercury ke roop mein machhliyon dwara shareer mein jaati hai.

qe: What is the 'pH' of Acid Rain typically?
qh: अम्लीय वर्षा का 'pH' आमतौर पर कितना होता है?
e: Amal (acid rain) ka pH sadharan taur par 5.6 se kam mana jaata hai - kyunki vaayumandal mein CO2 ghulne se shuddh paani ka pH 5.6 tak pahunch jaata hai; usa se kam pH hone par hi SO2 aur NOx se bane nitric tatha sulfuric acid ka asar maana jaata hai. Isi karan amal ka paani imaraton, dhatu, ped-paudhon aur jaleey jeevon ko nashtar karta hai. 7 ke aas-paas waala pH to sadharan (udaseen) paani ka hota hai aur 8 se upar kshariy hota hai - isliye wo vikalp amal ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: acid rain ka pH sadharan taran 5.6 se kam hota hai; iska mukhya kaaran SO2 aur NOx hain.

qe: What is 'Biogas' composed of?
qh: 'बायोगैस' मुख्य रूप से किन घटकों से बनी होती है?
e: Biogas (biogas) mukhya roop se methane (CH4) tatha carbon dioxide (CO2) ka mishran hai - aam taur par 50-70% methane aur 20-40% CO2, jisme thodi hydrogen sulfide (badbu ke liye) bhi hoti hai. Ye gobar, sabzi-kachre aur jaleey paudhon ke viyaviyan (anaerobic decomposition) se banta hai, isliye gaon mein ise gas-plant (ashta-kendra) mein istemal karke khana banana tatha bijli paida karna hota hai. LPG ke butane-propane se ye alag hai (CH4 ki matara zyada hone se ise 'gobar gas' bhi kehte hain). Nitrogen ya oxygen iska mukhya hissa nahi hain. Exam point: biogas mukhya roop se methane (CH4) aur carbon dioxide (CO2) ka mishran hai, jo hawa-bandi mein gobar/kachre ke viyan se banta hai.

qe: What is 'Bio-magnification'?
qh: 'बायो-मैग्निफिकेशन' (जैव आवर्धन) क्या है?
o: Increasing concentration of a toxic substance in the food chain
e: Bio-magnification (jaivik sanghanan) ka matlab hai khane ki shrinkhala (food chain) mein aage badhne par kisi akashmiss (her) padarth ki sandrata badhti jaati hai - jaise DDT paani se plankton (bahut der tak), machhali, us murgi aur phir manushy mein pahunchkar kai guna zyada ho jaata hai. Kyunki ye pradushak shareer se bahar nahi nikal paate (non-biodegradable), wo charbi (fat) mein jama hote rehte hain. Isi karan insan jaise top-level jeev mein zeher ki matara sabse zyada milti hai. Iske ulat, padarth ka ghulna ya pH badalna iski paribhasha nahi hai. Exam point: khane ki shrinkhala mein aage badhne par zeherili padarth ki matara badhna = bio-magnification (DDT, mercury jaise non-biodegradable padarthon mein dikhta hai).

qe: Which gas was the main cause of the 'Bhopal Gas Tragedy'?
qh: 'भोपाल गैस त्रासदी' का मुख्य कारण कौन सी गैस थी?
e: 1984 ki Bhopal gas trajedi mein Mukhya gas methyl isocyanate (MIC) thi - Union Carbide ki keetnashak (pesticide) factory ki tank mein paani jaane se MIC ki kriya hui aur zeherili gas hawa mein phail gayi, jisse hazaron log maare gaye tatha lakhon beemar hue. Isi ghatna ke baad Bharat mein paryavaran sanrakshan adhiniyam (1986) aaya aur audyogik suraksha ke niyam kadi kiye gaye. Phosgene, chlorine ya hydrogen cyanide alag zeherili gases hain jo is ghatna ki mukhya gas nahi thi (MIC kuchh tootne par wo bhi bante hain). Exam point: Bhopal gas trajedi (1984) ki mukhya gas = methyl isocyanate (MIC), jo Union Carbide factory se hawa mein faili thi.

qe: What is 'Humus' in soil?
qh: मृदा में 'ह्यूमस' (Humus) क्या है?
e: Soil mein humus wo gahra bhoora-kaala padarth hota hai jo paudhon tatha jaanvaron ke avshesh ke sukshm-jeevon dwara sadne (decompose) hone se banta hai - ismein kaarbanik (organic) padarth ki matara bahut adhik hoti hai. Humus mitti ko upjau banata hai kyunki wo paani tatha poshak tattv rok kar rakhta hai, mitti ko bhurbhura rakhta hai aur sukshm-jeevon ke liye bhojan deta hai. Sadhe hue patte-hi kachre ka antim sthir roop yahi hai. Khaniz (mineral) ya jeevit jeev humus nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: humus = mitti mein bana sadhe (decayed) jaivik padarth ka gahra bhoora hissa, jo mitti ki upjaau shakti badhata hai.

qe: What is 'Photochemical Smog' composed of?
qh: 'प्रकाश रासायनिक स्मॉग' (Photochemical Smog) किससे बना होता है?
e: Photochemical smog (prikash-rasayanik dhund) tab banta hai jab vaahan tatha udyogon se nikle nitrogen oxides (NOx) aur volatile organic compounds (VOC) suraj ki roshni ki UV kirnon se kriya karte hain - is kriya se ozon (O3), PAN tatha aldehydes jaise drvitiy pradushak bante hain. Yehi karan hai ki aise dhund dopahar ke baad sabse zyada dikhti hai tatha aankhon aur saans ko taklif deti hai. Sadharan CO2, SO2 ya dhool is dhund ke mukhya ghatak nahi hain (wo alag prakar ka pradushan hain). Exam point: photochemical smog ke mukhya ghatak = ozon, PAN tatha nitrogen oxides hain, jo UV roshni ki kriya se bante hain.

qe: What is 'Blue Baby Syndrome' caused by in groundwater?
qh: भूजल में किसकी अधिकता के कारण 'ब्लू बेबी सिंड्रोम' होता है?
e: Blue baby syndrome (methemoglobinemia) bachchon mein tab hota hai jab peene ke paani mein nitrate ki matara bahut zyada ho - shareer mein ye nitrate nitrite mein badal jaata hai jo khoon ke haemoglobin se jud kar ushe oxygen vahan karne ke kaabil nahi chhodta, isliye bachche ki twacha neeli pad jaati hai aur dum ghatne lagti hai. Isi karan kheti-lon wale kshetron mein well (kuen) ka paani jaanch kar peene ki salah di jaati hai. Fluoride ki adhikta se daant (fluorosis) aur lead se ananya sankat hote hain - wo blue baby syndrome nahi banate. Exam point: blue baby syndrome jameen ke paani mein nitrate ki adhikta se hota hai; nitrate khoon mein haemoglobin ko prabhavit karta hai.

qe: What is 'Green Chemistry'?
qh: 'हरित रसायन' (Green Chemistry) क्या है?
o: Designing chemical products/processes that reduce hazardous substances
e: Green chemistry (haria rasayan) ek aisa soch hai jismein rasayanik utpad tatha kriyaon ko aise banaya-design kiya jaata hai ki hanikarak (hazardous) padarth kam baney tatha kam istemal honn - yani kam kachra, kam zeher aur urja ki bachat. Iske 12 siddhant hain, jaise atmiya utpreran (catalysis), naveniya (renewable) ka kachra kam karna aur jaleey solvent ke jagah jal istemal karna. Iska maksad pradushan ko baad mein saaf karna nahi, balki shuru se hi rokna hota hai. Isliye purane tarike se rasayan banana ya pradushan badhana iske ulta hain. Exam point: green chemistry ka maksad aise process/product banana hai jismein hanikarak padarth kam banein - pradushan rokna shuru se hi.

qe: What is 'DDT'?
qh: 'DDT' क्या है?
e: DDT (dichloro-diphenyl-trichloroethane) ek aisa keetnashak (insecticide) hai jise jeev-ksheen (bacteria) tod nahi paate, isliye ye 'n-kabhi-nasht' (non-biodegradable) hota hai - ye mitti tatha paani mein saloon tak bana rehta hai aur khane ki shrinkhala mein chadh kar jeevon ke shareer mein jama hota hai (bio-magnification). Isi karan DDT pakshi ke andon ki khokhli kar deta hai aur aaj iska istemal lagbhag sabhi deshon mein ban hai. Urea ya superphosphate jaise khad isse alag hain kyunki wo poshak tattv hain, zeher nahi. Exam point: DDT ek non-biodegradable (na sadne wala) keetnashak hai - isi karan ye jeevon ke shareer mein jama hota hai aur aaj banned hai.

qe: Which substance is responsible for 'Global Warming' besides CO2?
qh: CO2 के अलावा 'ग्लोबल वार्मिंग' के लिए कौन सा पदार्थ जिम्मेदार है?
e: Global warming ke liye CO2 ke saath-saath methane (CH4), nitrous oxide (N2O) tatha chlorofluorocarbon (CFC) bhi uttaradayi hain - in sabhi ko greenhouse gas kaha jaata hai, kyunki ye infraraid (garmi) kirnon ko rok kar vaayumandal ka tapman badhate hain. Methane pashudhan tatha dhan (rice) ke kheton se aur CFC refrigerator-aerosol se nikalta hai; kaafi kam matara mein bhi ye CO2 se kai guna adhik garam karte hain (global warming potential). Isliye is prashn mein 'all of the above' wala jod sahi hai. Sadharan oxygen-nitrogen is asar mein bhumika nahi rakhte. Exam point: CO2 ke ilawa methane, nitrous oxide tatha CFC bhi global warming ke liye uttaradayi greenhouse gas hain.

qe: What is the primary cause of 'Minamata' disease?
qh: 'मिनीमाता' रोग का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
e: Minamata rog ka mool kaaran udyog ke kachre se paani mein pahunchi para (mercury) hai; wo paani ke jeevon tatha machhliyon ke shareer mein methylmercury ke roop mein jama hoti hai, isliye jo log aisi machhli khaate hain unke dimaag tatha nas (nerves) par asar hota hai - haath-pair kampna, kamzori tatha sunna kam hona isra aam lakshan hain. Japan ke Minamata kshetra mein yahi ghatna hui thi, isliye bimari ka naam wahi se pada. Isi karan machhli mein para ki jaanch aur audyogik bahav (effluent) par niyam bane. Exam point: Minamata rog ka mukhya kaaran = paani-machhli mein pahunchi para (mercury), jo methylmercury bankar shareer mein zaher failati hai.

qe: Which gas is used in 'Refrigerators' for cooling (Modern)?
qh: आधुनिक 'रेफ्रिजरेटर' में शीतलन के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aaj-kal ke refrigerator tatha AC mein HFC (hydrofluorocarbon) gases istemal hoti hain - ye thanda karne ke liye compressor-chakra ke andar gas tatha drav ke roop badalti hain aur chhote tapman par aasaani se vashpeekaran (vaporise) hoti hain. Pehle CFC (Freon) istemal hota tha, jo ozone ki parat todta hai, isliye Montreal protocol ke baad HFC par shift hua - kyunki HFC ozone ko nahi todta (par wo greenhouse gas hai, isliye aaj HFO aage badh rahe hain). Ammonia bhi thanda karne mein istemal hota hai par aam gharelu fridge mein HFC hi chalta hai. Exam point: aadhunik refrigerator ka cooling gas = HFC (hydrofluorocarbon), jo ozone ki parat ko nahi todta (CFC ki jagah aaya).

qe: Which gas is released during the 'Fermentation' of sugar?
qh: चीनी के 'किण्वन' (Fermentation) के दौरान कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Cheeni (sugar) ke viyan (fermentation) mein khameer (yeast) ke enzymes sugar ko alcohol tatha carbon dioxide (CO2) mein todte hain - isi karan sharab, beer tatha wine banane ke dauraan CO2 ke bulbule nikalte hain aur aata phoolta hai (bread, bhature, cake). Bina oxygen wali (anaerobic) is kriya ka samikaran hai: C6H12O6 se 2C2H5OH + 2CO2. Isi karan bakery mein yeast daala jaata hai aur carbonated drinks mein CO2 bharta hai. Oxygen ya hydrogen gas is kriya mein nahi nikalta, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sugar ke fermentation me mukhya gas = carbon dioxide (CO2), jo yeast dwara sugar todne par paida hoti hai (saath mein alcohol banta hai).

qe: Which allotrope of Carbon is a 'Good Conductor' of electricity?
qh: कार्बन का कौन सा अपररूप बिजली का 'सुचालक' है?
e: Graphite carbon ka wo roop (allotrope) hai jismein har carbon teen carbon ke saath tatha chautha electron poore dhanche mein delocalised (swatantra) rehta hai - isi mukta electron ki upasthiti ke karan graphite bijli tatha garmi ka achha chaalak banta hai. Isi gun se graphite ke electrode battery, dry cell tatha bijli-ki-bhatti (arc) mein istemal hote hain. Heera, fullerene ya amorphus carbon bijli ke kharab chaalak hain (heere mein electron ke bandh hone se chaalakata nahi hoti), isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: carbon ka wo roop jo bijli ka achha chaalak hai = graphite, kyunki uske delocalised electron svatantra roop se chalte hain.

qe: What is the 'Valency' of Carbon?
qh: कार्बन की 'संयोजकता' (Valency) क्या है?
e: Carbon ka valency (samyojakata) 4 hota hai, kyunki uske sabse bahari kosh mein 4 electron hote hain aur octet poora karne ke liye ushe 4 aur electron chahiye - isliye carbon chaar bandhan banaata hai (jaise CH4 mein chaar, CO2 mein chaar, aur heere mein chaar). Isi chaar bandhan wali kshamta ke karan carbon aapas mein lambi-lambi shrinkhala (catenation) bana kar lakhon yaugik banata hai, jiske karan 'organic chemistry' ka poora vishay bana. 2, 3 ya 6 valency carbon ke liye sahi nahi hain (2 to oxygen ki valency hai). Exam point: carbon ki valency 4 hai - isliye wo chaar bandhan banata hai aur catenation ke karan yaugikon ki lambi shrinkhala banaata hai.

qe: Which gas is also known as 'Marsh Gas'?
qh: किस गैस को 'मार्श गैस' भी कहा जाता है?
e: Marsh gas methane (CH4) hai - ye naam isliye pada kyunki ye daldal (marsh) tatha chhaale-jaisi geele kshetron mein paudhon ke avshesh sadne (decompose hone) se banta hai. Yahi gas gobar-gas plant, koyla-khan tatha rice ke kheton se nikalne wali 'biogas' ka mukhya ghatak hai aur ek prabal greenhouse gas bhi hai (isliye gaay/pashudhan iska bada srot mane jaate hain). Ethane, propane ya hydrogen ko marsh gas nahi kehte, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: methane (CH4) ko marsh gas kehte hain kyunki ye daldal/gehri jagahon mein jaivik padarth sadne se banta hai (gobar gas ka mukhya ghatak).
